title.en: Reasonix 1.38: Independent search, resilient recovery, and a unified desktop workspace
title.zh: Reasonix 1.38：独立搜索、可靠恢复与统一桌面工作区

summary.en: This release separates web search from the main conversation, hardens protocol recovery, and unifies desktop management pages. It also improves link menus, update relaunch stability, model image capability handling, and session actions.
summary.zh: 此版本将网络搜索与主对话分离，增强协议恢复可靠性，并统一桌面管理页面。同时改进了链接菜单、更新重启稳定性、模型图像能力处理以及会话操作。

body.en: Learn how to use the unified management pages for settings, trash, and automation.
body.zh: 了解如何使用统一的设置、回收站和自动化管理页面。

body.en: Understand how model capabilities are discovered and overridden.
body.zh: 了解模型能力的发现与覆盖方式。

body.en: Configure provider and model settings with the new editor.
body.zh: 使用新编辑器配置提供程序和模型设置。

body.en: Details on the independent web search feature.
body.zh: 独立网络搜索功能的详细信息。

body.en: Web search now runs separately from the main conversation, with its own recovery budget and clear reporting when structured sources are missing.
body.zh: 网络搜索现在独立于主对话运行，拥有自己的恢复预算，并在缺少结构化来源时提供清晰报告。

body.en: Eligible protocol failures now offer a one-time recovery from valid history through the Desktop button, CLI /recover-context, Serve, and ACP. Recovery survives restart and respects cancellation.
body.zh: 可恢复的协议错误现在支持通过桌面按钮、CLI /recover-context、Serve 和 ACP 从有效历史恢复一次，重启后保留恢复状态，并遵守取消操作。

body.en: Settings, Trash, and Automation now use full-window management pages with shared navigation and focus isolation, while keeping the workspace mounted.
body.zh: 设置、回收站和自动化现在使用全窗口管理页面，具有共享导航和焦点隔离，同时保持工作区挂载。

body.en: Web, GitHub, and mail links now have context menus with open/copy actions and compact GitHub references, with full keyboard support.
body.zh: 网络、GitHub 和邮件链接现在具有上下文菜单，提供打开/复制操作和紧凑的 GitHub 引用，并支持完整的键盘操作。

body.en: Versioned updates now relaunch through the permanent launcher, and the update banner refreshes hourly and on focus without interrupting active operations.
body.zh: 版本化更新现在通过永久启动器重启，更新横幅每小时及获得焦点时刷新，不会中断正在进行的操作。

body.en: Provider models with unknown image capability can now be manually enabled or disabled, with official protocol restrictions taking precedence.
body.zh: 图像能力未知的提供程序模型现在可以手动启用或禁用，官方协议限制优先。

body.en: Added context menus for web, GitHub, and mail links with open, copy, and compact reference actions.
body.zh: 为网络、GitHub 和邮件链接添加了上下文菜单，包含打开、复制和紧凑引用操作。

body.en: Settings, Trash, and Automation now use full-window management pages with shared navigation and focus isolation.
body.zh: 设置、回收站和自动化现在使用全窗口管理页面，具有共享导航和焦点隔离。

body.en: Web search is decoupled from the main conversation with its own recovery budget and reporting.
body.zh: 网络搜索与主对话解耦，拥有自己的恢复预算和报告。

body.en: Eligible protocol failures now offer a one-time recovery from valid history through the Desktop button, CLI /recover-context, Serve, and ACP. Recovery survives restart and respects cancellation.
body.zh: 可恢复的协议错误现在支持通过桌面按钮、CLI /recover-context、Serve 和 ACP 从有效历史恢复一次，重启后保留恢复状态，并遵守取消操作。

body.en: Added per-model Auto/On/Off image input control and improved capability discovery for relays.
body.zh: 添加了每个模型的自动/开/关图像输入控制，并改进了中转站的能力发现。

body.en: Copy, export, terminal, and summary actions are now directly available in the topic bar.
body.zh: 复制、导出、终端和摘要操作现在可直接在主题栏中使用。

body.en: Relaunch now uses the permanent launcher, and tray identity and recovery are more reliable.
body.zh: 重启现在使用永久启动器，托盘身份和恢复更加可靠。

body.en: Fixed overlapping controls when opening Automation tasks, including Windows caption buttons and macOS workspace toggle.
body.zh: 修复了打开自动化任务时控件重叠的问题，包括 Windows 标题按钮和 macOS 工作区切换。

body.en: Workspace tabs now share the title row with the toggle, preventing overlap at minimum dock width.
body.zh: 工作区选项卡现在与切换按钮共享标题行，防止在最小停靠宽度下重叠。

body.en: Built-in DeepSeek conversations use Chat Completions again while web search runs independently through the official search endpoint. The one-time configuration upgrade preserves model, effort, search preferences and explicit custom routes.
body.zh: 内置 DeepSeek 主对话恢复使用 Chat Completions，网络搜索独立使用官方搜索端点。一次性配置升级保留模型、思考等级、搜索偏好和显式自定义路由。

body.en: A model may request a completed read-only tool again after protocol repair. Verified file-write recovery prevents repeated satisfied writes, but this is not a guarantee for arbitrary shell or MCP effects. Older clients can read ordinary history but cannot enforce the new recovery accounting; do not use a downgrade to resume an unresolved protocol incident.
body.zh: 协议修复后，模型可能再次请求已经完成的只读工具。已验证的文件写入恢复可避免重复执行已满足的写入，但不能据此保证任意 shell 或 MCP 副作用不重复。旧客户端可读取普通历史，但无法执行新的恢复约束；请勿通过降级续跑尚未解决的协议故障。

summary.en: This release simplifies the agent core, improves provider capability handling, stabilizes desktop scrolling, and adds ModelScope as a provider preset.
summary.zh: 此版本简化了 Agent 核心，改进了提供商能力处理，稳定了桌面滚动，并新增 ModelScope 提供商预设。

body.en: Learn about the simplified agent loop, explicit planner and continuation policies, and the new deterministic completion flow.
body.zh: 了解简化的 Agent 循环、显式的 planner 和 continuation 策略，以及新的确定性完成流程。

body.en: Details on model-level vision capabilities and the new capability metadata contract.
body.zh: 关于模型级视觉能力和新能力元数据契约的详细信息。

body.en: Updated reasoning replay and recovery behavior for OpenAI-compatible providers.
body.zh: 针对 OpenAI 兼容提供商的推理回放和恢复行为更新。

title.en: Simplified agent core with deterministic completion
title.zh: 简化 Agent 核心并采用确定性完成流程

body.en: The agent loop is now executor-only by default, with explicit opt-in for planner, continuation, and compaction. Completion no longer uses a second LLM validator; empty responses retry the same frozen request.
body.zh: Agent 循环现在默认仅执行器，planner、continuation 和 compaction 需显式启用。完成不再使用第二个 LLM 验证器；空响应会重试相同的冻结请求。

body.en: Vision support is now determined by model-level capability metadata instead of manual VisionModels lists, with automatic parsing from provider /models responses.
body.zh: 视觉支持现在由模型级能力元数据决定，而非手动 VisionModels 列表，并自动从提供商 /models 响应解析。

body.en: Added ModelScope as an OpenAI-compatible provider preset with 7 curated models, including Qwen3.5-397B and DeepSeek-V4.
body.zh: 新增 ModelScope 作为 OpenAI 兼容提供商预设，包含 7 个精选模型，如 Qwen3.5-397B 和 DeepSeek-V4。

body.en: Fixed multiple scroll jump issues, including reduced-motion compounding, block-window prepends, and late range commits.
body.zh: 修复了多个滚动跳动问题，包括减少动画叠加、块窗口前插和延迟范围提交。

title.en: Management commands no longer require a turn ID
title.zh: 管理命令不再需要回合 ID

body.en: Slash commands like /compact and /context now complete without creating an agent turn, avoiding spurious errors.
body.zh: /compact 和 /context 等斜杠命令现在无需创建 Agent 回合即可完成，避免虚假错误。

body.en: Added ModelScope as an OpenAI-compatible provider preset with 7 curated models.
body.zh: 新增 ModelScope 作为 OpenAI 兼容提供商预设，包含 7 个精选模型。

body.en: Replaced manual VisionModels with model-level capability metadata, including automatic parsing from provider /models responses.
body.zh: 用模型级能力元数据取代手动 VisionModels，包括自动从提供商 /models 响应解析。

body.en: Removed the completion validator second-LLM request; empty responses retry the same frozen request, and reasoning-only responses may finish without visible text.
body.zh: 移除了完成验证器的第二次 LLM 请求；空响应重试相同的冻结请求，仅推理的响应可能在没有可见文本的情况下完成。

body.en: Ordinary requests are executor-only; planner and continuation are opt-in. Pressure compaction is one summary plus one retry.
body.zh: 普通请求仅执行器；planner 和 continuation 需显式启用。压力压缩为一次摘要加一次重试。

body.en: Replay historical reasoning_content turns when tools are declared, and self-heal stale-history 400 errors.
body.zh: 当声明工具时回放历史 reasoning_content 回合，并自愈旧历史 400 错误。

body.en: Preserve and recover subagent outcomes with a new SubagentOutcome envelope and typed errors.
body.zh: 使用新的 SubagentOutcome 封装和类型化错误保留并恢复子代理结果。

body.en: Stabilized prompt prefixes by moving mutable environment and skill catalogs into deterministic session-context snapshots.
body.zh: 通过将可变环境和技能目录移入确定性会话上下文快照来稳定提示词前缀。

body.en: Moved user-visible agent host notices into the i18n catalog and synchronized language changes live.
body.zh: 将用户可见的 Agent 主机提示移入 i18n 目录，并实时同步语言更改。

body.en: Removed Classic layout from Settings and migrated existing classic configs to Workbench.
body.zh: 从设置中移除经典布局，并将现有经典配置迁移到工作台。

body.en: Restored legacy provider-level unsupported vision signal after model-level capability metadata became authoritative.
body.zh: 在模型级能力元数据成为权威后，恢复了旧版提供商级不支持视觉信号。

body.en: Removed the long-lived fallback circuit; now one deterministic protocol retry before returning the provider-specific error.
body.zh: 移除了长期回退电路；现在在返回提供商特定错误前进行一次确定性协议重试。

body.en: Management slash commands no longer require a durable turn ID, avoiding spurious errors.
body.zh: 管理斜杠命令不再需要持久回合 ID，避免虚假错误。

body.en: Fixed reduced-motion compounding, block-window prepend absorption, and late range commit guard.
body.zh: 修复了减少动画叠加、块窗口前插吸收和延迟范围提交保护。

body.en: Fenced scrollbar transactions by generation to prevent stale geometry from causing jumps.
body.zh: 按 generation 围栏滚动条事务，防止旧几何导致跳动。

body.en: Omitted empty fenced code blocks to remove phantom cards.
body.zh: 省略空代码围栏块以移除幻影卡片。

body.en: Bounded D1 group-detail reads and capped facets to prevent Worker 1101 errors.
body.zh: 限制 D1 分组详情读取并限制 facet 数量，防止 Worker 1101 错误。

title.zh: 网站 D1 查询优化

body.en: Added performance indexes and keyset pagination for forum and registry queries.
body.zh: 为论坛和注册表查询添加性能索引和 keyset 分页。

title.en: Reasonix 1.36: Sticky context pinning, session takeover, and long-file read enforcement
title.zh: Reasonix 1.36：粘性上下文固定、会话接管与长文件读取强制

summary.en: This release adds sticky context file pinning to Desktop, cooperative session takeover across Desktop and CLI, and enforced complete long-file reads. It also brings numerous stability and performance fixes for the CLI and Desktop.
summary.zh: 此版本为桌面端新增粘性上下文文件固定，为桌面端与 CLI 新增协作式会话接管，并强制完成长文件读取。同时带来大量 CLI 与桌面端的稳定性与性能修复。

body.en: Learn how cooperative session takeover and reclaim work across Desktop and CLI.
body.zh: 了解协作式会话接管与取回如何在桌面端与 CLI 之间工作。

body.en: Chinese guide to cooperative session takeover and reclaim across Desktop and CLI.
body.zh: 协作式会话接管与取回在桌面端和 CLI 中工作方式的中文指南。

body.en: Pin workspace files to a session so they remain available verbatim after context compaction. Pinned files are delivered as append-only user-role revisions before the next accepted turn, without rewriting the system prompt or invalidating the prompt cache.
body.zh: 将会话中的工作区文件固定，使其在上下文压缩后仍可逐字保留。固定文件在下一次接受的轮次前以仅追加的用户角色修订形式传递，不会重写系统提示或使提示缓存失效。

body.en: Take over a session from another client with a cooperative handoff. Exactly one writer owns a session at a time; the other side stays attached as a read-only spectator and can reclaim ownership cooperatively.
body.zh: 通过协作式移交从另一个客户端接管会话。同一时间只有一个写入者拥有会话；另一方保持只读旁观状态，并可协作式取回所有权。

body.en: Long read_file results now use a dynamic budget and block mutations, finalizers, and final answers until every incomplete read is resolved. This prevents the model from silently missing rules near the end of a file.
body.zh: 长 read_file 结果现在使用动态预算，并阻止变更、终结器和最终答案，直到所有不完整读取得到解决。这可以防止模型静默遗漏文件末尾附近的规则。

title.en: Graceful watchdog exit and clock-jump tolerance
title.zh: watchdog 优雅退出与时钟跳变容忍

body.en: The interactive TUI no longer hard-kills on recoverable stalls and tolerates wall-clock jumps after suspend/resume, preventing false 'program was killed' errors on Windows.
body.zh: 交互式 TUI 不再在可恢复的停滞时硬杀进程，并容忍挂起/恢复后的时钟跳变，防止 Windows 上出现错误的“程序被杀死”错误。

title.zh: 防止 Ask 提示循环

body.en: Resolve missing local turn IDs from authoritative state before answering an Ask prompt, and fence cleanup by prompt ID and controller epoch so late completions cannot clear a newer prompt.
body.zh: 在回答 Ask 提示前从权威状态解析缺失的本地轮次 ID，并通过提示 ID 和控制器纪元隔离清理，使迟到的完成不会清除更新的提示。

body.en: Pin workspace files to a session so they remain available verbatim after context compaction.
body.zh: 将会话中的工作区文件固定，使其在上下文压缩后仍可逐字保留。

body.en: Take over a session from another client with a cooperative handoff and reclaim ownership cooperatively.
body.zh: 通过协作式移交从另一个客户端接管会话，并协作式取回所有权。

body.en: Long read_file results now use a dynamic budget and block mutations, finalizers, and final answers until every incomplete read is resolved.
body.zh: 长 read_file 结果现在使用动态预算，并阻止变更、终结器和最终答案，直到所有不完整读取得到解决。

body.en: Completion validation now defaults to enforce mode, using a model-based semantic check instead of keyword matching to prevent incomplete turns from being accepted.
body.zh: 完成校验现在默认使用 enforce 模式，采用基于模型的语义检查而非关键词匹配，防止接受不完整的轮次。

title.zh: 停止空闲 CPU 修复循环

body.en: The session catalog no longer replays recovery transcripts after strict verification, preventing idle CPU repair loops.
body.zh: 会话目录在严格验证后不再重放恢复转录，防止空闲 CPU 修复循环。

body.en: Slash argument completion data is now cached across keystrokes, eliminating input lag when a completion popup is open.
body.zh: 斜杠参数补全数据现在在按键间缓存，消除补全弹窗打开时的输入卡顿。

body.en: Isolated worktrees now support one-click diff, conflict precheck, and merge-back to the main branch with failure-atomic safety.
body.zh: 隔离工作树现在支持一键差异对比、冲突预检与合并回主分支，并具备失败原子安全性。

title.en: Graceful watchdog exit and clock-jump tolerance
title.zh: watchdog 优雅退出与时钟跳变容忍

body.en: The interactive TUI no longer hard-kills on recoverable stalls and tolerates wall-clock jumps after suspend/resume.
body.zh: 交互式 TUI 不再在可恢复的停滞时硬杀进程，并容忍挂起/恢复后的时钟跳变。

title.zh: 防止 Ask 提示循环

body.en: Resolve missing local turn IDs from authoritative state before answering an Ask prompt, and fence cleanup by prompt ID and controller epoch.
body.zh: 在回答 Ask 提示前从权威状态解析缺失的本地轮次 ID，并通过提示 ID 和控制器纪元隔离清理。

body.en: On Wayland and X11, image paste now negotiates supported MIME types and falls back to text instead of silently failing.
body.zh: 在 Wayland 和 X11 上，图片粘贴现在协商支持的 MIME 类型，并在失败时回退到文本，而不是静默失败。

title.zh: SSH 会话强制同步输出

body.en: The TUI now forces synchronized output over SSH to eliminate flicker when typing in remote sessions.
body.zh: TUI 现在在 SSH 会话中强制同步输出，消除远程会话中输入时的闪烁。

title.zh: SSH 会话默认原生鼠标

body.en: SSH sessions now start with native mouse selection enabled by default, so users can select and copy terminal output.
body.zh: SSH 会话现在默认启用原生鼠标选择，使用户可以选择和复制终端输出。

title.zh: 控制器派发轮次时进入运行态

body.en: The TUI now enters running state when the controller auto-dispatches a queued follow-up, preventing input races and silent drops.
body.zh: 当控制器自动派发排队的后续任务时，TUI 现在进入运行状态，防止输入竞争和静默丢弃。

title.en: Strip block gutters from selection copy
title.zh: 应用内选区复制剥离装饰竖线

body.en: Copying rendered TUI output no longer includes application-owned gutters, while preserving literal glyphs and indentation.
body.zh: 复制渲染的 TUI 输出不再包含应用拥有的装饰竖线，同时保留字面字形和缩进。

title.en: Retain transcript anchor on plain click
title.zh: 修复普通点击触发会话回跳

body.en: Plain clicks on transcript content no longer cause the viewport to jump after manual scrolling.
body.zh: 手动滚动后，普通点击转录内容不再导致视口跳动。

title.zh: 修复 Ask 会话首次切换失败

body.en: An Ask prompt that arrives between topic activation ticketing and terminal readiness is now preserved.
body.zh: 在主题激活票据与终端就绪之间到达的 Ask 提示现在会被保留。

title.en: Surface /preset in completion, help, and status line
title.zh: 让 /preset 在 TUI 完成列表、帮助与状态栏可见

body.en: The /preset command now appears in slash completion, help, and the status line, with argument completion for standard and delivery.
body.zh: /preset 命令现在出现在斜杠补全、帮助和状态栏中，并提供 standard 和 delivery 的参数补全。

title.en: Name valid operations on unknown command
title.zh: 未知操作时列出有效操作

body.en: When rejecting an unknown operation, hook, session, and task now list the valid operations and echo the rejected name.
body.zh: 当拒绝未知操作时，hook、session 和 task 现在会列出有效操作并回显被拒绝的名称。

summary.en: This release brings isolated Git worktree forks, chunked-summary recovery for over-length sessions, a simplified session recovery versions dialog, and numerous stability fixes for transcript scrolling, compaction, and session catalog identity.
summary.zh: 此版本带来隔离 Git Worktree 分叉、超长会话的分块摘要恢复、简化的会话恢复版本对话框，以及针对转录滚动、压缩和会话目录身份的众多稳定性修复。

body.en: Learn how isolated worktree forks and session ownership work.
body.zh: 了解隔离工作树分叉和会话所有权的工作原理。

body.en: Chinese guide for session ownership and isolated worktree forks.
body.zh: 会话所有权和隔离工作树分叉的中文指南。

body.en: Understand session catalog identity and path handling.
body.zh: 了解会话目录身份和路径处理。

body.en: Chinese guide for session catalog identity and path handling.
body.zh: 会话目录身份和路径处理的中文指南。

body.en: Details on configuration paths and workspace-root identity.
body.zh: 配置路径和工作区根身份的详细信息。

body.en: Chinese guide for configuration paths and workspace-root identity.
body.zh: 配置路径和工作区根身份的中文指南。

body.en: General usage guide including YOLO mode /clear behavior.
body.zh: 一般使用指南，包括 YOLO 模式 /clear 行为。

body.en: Chinese general usage guide including YOLO mode /clear behavior.
body.zh: 中文一般使用指南，包括 YOLO 模式 /clear 行为。

body.en: Details on tool approval modes and YOLO /clear fast path.
body.zh: 工具审批模式和 YOLO /clear 快速路径的详细信息。

body.en: Chinese guide for tool approval modes and YOLO /clear fast path.
body.zh: 工具审批模式和 YOLO /clear 快速路径的中文指南。

title.en: Fork conversations into isolated Git worktrees
title.zh: 将会话分叉至隔离 Git Worktree

body.en: You can now fork a conversation from any message turn into a new tab backed by a dedicated Git worktree, keeping exploratory work separate from your source checkout. Shared-workspace forks remain available.
body.zh: 现在可以从任意消息轮次将会话分叉到由专用 Git 工作树支持的新标签页，使探索性工作与源检出保持分离。共享工作区分叉仍然可用。

title.en: Recover over-length sessions with chunked summaries
title.zh: 使用分块摘要恢复超长会话

body.en: When a single summary request fails due to output truncation or window overflow, /compact now automatically falls back to chunked summaries with tree merging and installs a working compaction projection in the current session.
body.zh: 当单次摘要请求因输出截断或窗口溢出而失败时，/compact 现在会自动回退到分块摘要和树形归并，并在当前会话中安装可工作的压缩投影。

body.en: Session recovery is now presented as a single lazy versions dialog. Covered recovery copies are hidden from ordinary history and grouped under a collapsed System recovery data section in Trash.
body.zh: 会话恢复现在以单一的延迟版本对话框呈现。被覆盖的恢复副本从普通历史中隐藏，并在回收站中归入折叠的“系统恢复数据”部分。

title.en: Stabilized transcript scrolling and history rendering
title.zh: 稳定转录滚动和历史渲染

body.en: Multiple fixes prevent visible jumps during history prepends, ensure historical markdown renders without waiting for bottom scroll, and stabilize same-tab tail takeover.
body.zh: 多项修复防止历史预置期间出现可见跳动，确保历史 Markdown 无需等待滚动到底即可渲染，并稳定同标签页尾部接管。

body.en: Automatic summary requests are now capped at the configured context window, manual compaction can escape over-ceiling deadlocks, and small shared windows remain admissible.
body.zh: 自动摘要请求现在按配置的上下文窗口封顶，手动压缩可以摆脱超顶死锁，小型共享窗口保持可接受。

title.zh: 统一会话目录路径身份

body.en: Session catalog now uses filesystem-aware identity keys, preventing duplicate entries on case-insensitive filesystems and preserving distinct paths on case-sensitive ones.
body.zh: 会话目录现在使用文件系统感知的身份键，防止在大小写不敏感的文件系统上出现重复条目，并在大小写敏感的文件系统上保留不同路径。

body.en: Terminally failed sessions no longer cause restart loops and can be archived through the regular TrashTopic path.
body.zh: 最终失败的会话不再导致重启循环，并可通过常规 TrashTopic 路径归档。

title.zh: 回滚选择器显示用户提示

body.en: The rewind picker now correctly strips interleaved compose prefixes and records raw prompts, so you can see your own words instead of injected notices.
body.zh: 回滚选择器现在正确剥离交错的组合前缀并记录原始提示，因此您可以看到自己的话语而不是注入的通知。

title.zh: YOLO 模式跳过 /clear 确认

body.en: In YOLO mode, /clear now clears the session immediately without a confirmation overlay.
body.zh: 在 YOLO 模式下，/clear 现在立即清除会话，无需确认覆盖层。

title.en: Fork conversations into isolated Git worktrees
title.zh: 将会话分叉至隔离 Git Worktree

body.en: Fork from any message turn into a new tab backed by a dedicated Git worktree. Isolated forks create a reasonix/delivery-* branch and linked worktree from the committed HEAD. Shared forks keep the current directory and uncommitted changes. A dirty source checkout blocks isolated creation and asks to commit/stash or use a shared fork. When prerequisites are unavailable, the conversation falls back to shared workspace with a visible notice. Successfully referenced isolated worktrees are registered as projects and remain discoverable after closing a tab or restarting.
body.zh: 从任意消息轮次分叉到由专用 Git 工作树支持的新标签页。隔离分叉从已提交的 HEAD 创建 reasonix/delivery-* 分支和关联工作树。共享分叉保留当前目录和未提交的更改。源检出脏时阻止隔离创建，并要求提交/暂存或使用共享分叉。当先决条件不可用时，会话回退到共享工作区并显示可见通知。成功引用的隔离工作树注册为项目，关闭标签页或重启后仍可发现。

body.en: When a single summary request fails, /compact automatically splits the fold into replay-safe, exponentially sized chunks with overlap, summarizes fragments, tree-reduces briefings, and installs the resulting CompactionModeChunked projection in the current session without a second command.
body.zh: 当单次摘要请求失败时，/compact 自动将折叠拆分为可重放、指数大小且带重叠的块，总结片段，树形归并简报，并在当前会话中安装生成的 CompactionModeChunked 投影，无需第二次命令。

body.en: Recovery safety net remains, but physical recovery-copy concepts are removed from ordinary project-tree and history workflows. One non-blocking notification appears only after the catalog confirms a real divergent lineage, and both the notification and History route through the same lazy Session versions dialog. Covered copies are hidden from ordinary History and grouped under a collapsed System recovery data section in Trash. Opening a version does not change the default; choosing a default version does not delete, overwrite, merge, or make another divergent version cleanup-eligible.
body.zh: 恢复安全网保留，但物理恢复副本概念从普通项目树和历史工作流中移除。仅在目录确认真实分歧谱系后显示一个非阻塞通知，通知和历史都通过相同的延迟会话版本对话框。被覆盖的副本从普通历史中隐藏，并在回收站中归入折叠的“系统恢复数据”部分。打开版本不会更改默认值；选择默认版本不会删除、覆盖、合并或使另一个分歧版本符合清理条件。

body.en: Automatic pressure/overflow summaries are capped for shared and unknown gateways. Unknown gateways honor the effective configured or learned window. Shared/unknown summaries scale their output cap as min(8192, max(window/4, 512)), while independent-window providers retain the full 8192-token cap. Summary execution uses the same dedicated protocol reserve as planning, and compaction.prepare replacements are revalidated against the final-request limit.
body.zh: 自动压力/溢出摘要对共享和未知网关进行封顶。未知网关遵循有效配置或学习到的窗口。共享/未知摘要的输出上限缩放为 min(8192, max(window/4, 512))，而独立窗口提供者保留完整的 8192 令牌上限。摘要执行使用与规划相同的专用协议储备，compaction.prepare 替换根据最终请求限制重新验证。

title.en: Manual compaction escape from over-ceiling deadlock
title.zh: 手动压缩摆脱超顶死锁

body.en: Over the ceiling, a manual compact now prunes first, uses safe-prefix folding, and runs a rescue loop of up to 4 batches, each carrying the prior digest, until the view is under the ceiling or no balanced prefix remains. Below the ceiling, manual semantics are unchanged.
body.zh: 超过上限时，手动压缩现在先修剪，使用安全前缀折叠，并运行最多 4 个批次的救援循环，每个批次携带先前的摘要，直到视图低于上限或没有平衡前缀剩余。低于上限时，手动语义不变。

title.zh: 缩放共享窗口准入缓冲

body.en: The ordinary shared-window admission cushion now scales with the effective context window: 1/128, with a 256-token floor and 8K cap. This keeps small shared windows admissible and prevents unnecessary overflow folds.
body.zh: 普通共享窗口准入缓冲现在随有效上下文窗口缩放：1/128，下限 256 令牌，上限 8K。这使小型共享窗口保持可接受，并防止不必要的溢出折叠。

title.en: Unified filesystem path identity in session catalog
title.zh: 会话目录中统一的文件系统路径身份

body.en: Session catalog now separates original access spellings from filesystem-aware identity keys, used for Desktop and CLI targets, SQLite uniqueness, workspace relationships, scans, indexing, tombstones, repair ownership, and directory locks. Distinct /Foo and /foo entries are preserved on case-sensitive filesystems while equivalent spellings coalesce on case-insensitive ones. The disposable catalog moves to v6.sqlite with schema migration through v10.
body.zh: 会话目录现在将原始访问拼写与文件系统感知的身份键分离，用于桌面和 CLI 目标、SQLite 唯一性、工作区关系、扫描、索引、墓碑、修复所有权和目录锁。在大小写敏感的文件系统上保留不同的 /Foo 和 /foo 条目，而在大小写不敏感的文件系统上合并等效拼写。一次性目录移至 v6.sqlite，模式迁移至 v10。

body.en: Terminal session recovery failures no longer create restart loops. The filtered desktop-tabs.json snapshot is persisted immediately, and terminally failed sessions can be archived through the regular TrashTopic path without bypassing active-work protection.
body.zh: 最终会话恢复失败不再导致重启循环。过滤后的 desktop-tabs.json 快照立即持久化，最终失败的会话可通过常规 TrashTopic 路径归档，而不会绕过活动工作保护。

title.zh: 回滚选择器显示用户提示

body.en: The rewind picker now strips interleaved compose prefixes to a fixpoint and records raw prompts in the headless run path, so labels show the user's own words instead of injected notices.
body.zh: 回滚选择器现在将交错的组合前缀剥离到固定点，并在无头运行路径中记录原始提示，因此标签显示用户自己的话语而不是注入的通知。

title.zh: YOLO 模式跳过 /clear 确认

body.en: In YOLO mode, /clear clears the session immediately without a confirmation overlay. Non-YOLO modes keep the existing confirmation.
body.zh: 在 YOLO 模式下，/clear 立即清除会话，无需确认覆盖层。非 YOLO 模式保留现有确认。

body.en: Complex transcripts no longer visibly jump while older history is prepended. The fix captures the visible reader anchor by stable row key, holds contiguous pages under one generation-bound lease, fences reader correction until mounted coverage is stable, and routes the only physical correction through the existing generation-fenced scroll writer.
body.zh: 复杂转录在预置较旧历史时不再出现可见跳动。修复通过稳定行键捕获可见阅读器锚点，在一个代际绑定租约下持有连续页面，在挂载覆盖稳定之前隔离阅读器校正，并通过现有的代际隔离滚动写入器路由唯一的物理校正。

body.en: History-prepend geometry commits now have a wall-clock bound independent from reader input settling, preventing repeated downward wheels from postponing a covered prepend forever and blocking reader-to-tail handoff.
body.zh: 历史预置几何提交现在具有独立于阅读器输入稳定的墙钟界限，防止重复向下滚动无限期推迟已覆盖的预置并阻止阅读器到尾部交接。

title.zh: 稳定有界转录尾部确认

body.en: Tail-settle phase/frame metadata remains functional in Stable builds so bounded same-revision retries are not deduplicated. Repeat confirmation is required before treating a small WebView2 no-op residual as the reachable tail, while explicit jump-bottom still probes the theoretical physical extent.
body.zh: 尾部稳定阶段/帧元数据在稳定构建中保持功能，因此有界同修订重试不会被去重。在将小型 WebView2 无操作残差视为可达尾部之前需要重复确认，而显式跳到底部仍探测理论物理范围。

title.zh: 稳定同标签页转录尾部接管

body.en: Same-tab model takeover and reconnect now converge through the generation-bound tail transaction that actually runs on this path. A reveal-generation change synchronously invalidates the old layout surface, the incoming first-items transaction owns the tail, and wheel intent cancels delayed confirmations so the reader is never yanked back.
body.zh: 同标签页模型接管和重连现在通过实际在此路径上运行的代际绑定尾部事务收敛。揭示代际更改同步使旧布局表面失效，传入的首项事务拥有尾部，滚轮意图取消延迟确认，因此阅读器永远不会被拉回。

title.en: Historical markdown renders without waiting for bottom
title.zh: 历史 Markdown 无需等待底部即可渲染

body.en: Historical Markdown parsing can finish while the reader is above the transcript bottom. MarkdownHistory now classifies the actual Virtuoso row against the actual .transcript scroller: answers within the bounded tail window render immediately, mounted long rows outside the viewport render immediately, and long rows intersecting the reader viewport keep the complete fallback until the reader returns to the shared native reachable bottom.
body.zh: 历史 Markdown 解析可以在阅读器位于转录底部上方时完成。MarkdownHistory 现在根据实际的 .transcript 滚动器对实际的 Virtuoso 行进行分类：有界尾部窗口内的答案立即渲染，视口外已挂载的长行立即渲染，与阅读器视口相交的长行保留完整回退，直到阅读器返回共享的原生可达底部。

title.zh: 恢复发布包体预算余量

body.en: The merged isolated-worktree startup graph is measured at 2454.719 KiB, and 0.081 KiB of explicit headroom is retained with the existing one-decimal ratchet. All gzip, chunk, locale, and CSS budgets remain unchanged.
body.zh: 合并的隔离工作树启动图测量为 2454.719 KiB，并通过现有的一位小数棘轮保留 0.081 KiB 的显式余量。所有 gzip、块、区域设置和 CSS 预算保持不变。

title.zh: kill_shell 归类为仅主机状态变更

body.en: kill_shell no longer enters workspace write coordination or waits for the target job's path lease, preventing a self-blocking lifecycle operation when terminating a background job.
body.zh: kill_shell 不再进入工作区写协调或等待目标作业的路径租约，防止在终止后台作业时出现自阻塞生命周期操作。

summary.en: Security hardening for serve and git operations, MCP 2026 interactions and Apps, cache-stable capability controls, and multiple desktop stability fixes.
summary.zh: serve 与 git 操作的安全加固、MCP 2026 交互与 Apps、缓存稳定的能力控制，以及多项桌面稳定性修复。

body.en: Documentation for subagent profiles.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件文档。

body.en: Chinese documentation for subagent profiles.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件中文文档。

body.en: Documentation for the task contract.
body.zh: 任务契约文档。

body.en: Chinese documentation for the task contract.
body.zh: 任务契约中文文档。

body.en: Documentation for the tool contract.
body.zh: 工具契约文档。

body.en: Chinese documentation for the tool contract.
body.zh: 工具契约中文文档。

body.en: Documentation for capability replay evaluation.
body.zh: 能力使用回放评估文档。

body.en: Chinese documentation for capability replay evaluation.
body.zh: 能力使用回放评估中文文档。

body.en: Documentation for MCP 2026 Apps support.
body.zh: MCP 2026 Apps 支持文档。

body.en: Added support for MCP 2026 multi-round interactions and Desktop Apps with sandboxed rendering.
body.zh: 新增对 MCP 2026 多轮交互和桌面 Apps 的支持，并采用沙箱渲染。

body.en: Landed use_capability speed and quality controls, including parallel scheduling, review budgets, and metrics.
body.zh: 落地 use_capability 的速度与质量控制，包括并行调度、审查预算和指标。

title.zh: serve 与 git 操作安全加固

body.en: Closed six security-boundary gaps including DNS rebinding, preview confinement, and git clean-filter neutralization.
body.zh: 封堵六个安全边界缺口，包括 DNS 重绑定、预览越界读与 git clean 过滤器执行。

body.en: Fixed transcript reader transactions to prevent reverse jumps and blank frames during high-speed reasoning.
body.zh: 修复对话阅读滚动事务，防止高速推理时的反向跳跃和空白帧。

body.en: Fixed multi-round reasoning overwrites and tool timeline misalignment in the same turn.
body.zh: 修复同一 turn 内多次模型采样导致的多轮思考覆盖和工具时间线错位。

title.zh: 修复输入框自动高度抖动

body.en: Fixed composer autosize causing session viewport bounce by using an off-flow textarea mirror.
body.zh: 通过使用离流 textarea 镜像修复输入框自动高度导致的会话视口抖动。

title.en: Aligned model discovery with chat proxy policy
title.zh: 修复自定义供应商刷新正常但对话无响应

body.en: Fixed custom provider model discovery using a different network policy than chat, and made stream failures visible.
body.zh: 修复自定义供应商模型发现与聊天使用不同网络策略的问题，并使流失败可见。

title.en: Kept remote project roots out of local topic state
title.zh: 远端项目根不再触碰本地 Topic 元数据

body.en: Fixed a user-visible toast error when opening remote projects on Windows due to invalid path components.
body.zh: 修复在 Windows 上打开远端项目时因无效路径组件导致的用户可见 toast 错误。

title.en: Kept new-session blank row visible in remote groups
title.zh: 远端项目组新会话行稳定显示

body.en: Fixed the new-session blank row flashing and disappearing in remote workspace sidebars.
body.zh: 修复远端工作区侧边栏中新会话行闪烁后消失的问题。

title.en: Kept write path alive across in-place resume
title.zh: 修复 /resume 之后 /new 报写授权缺失

body.en: Fixed a 500 error when creating a new session after an in-place resume due to missing write authority.
body.zh: 修复原地 /resume 后创建新会话时因写授权缺失导致的 500 错误。

title.zh: 修复 Streamable HTTP 兼容性

body.en: Fixed MCP Streamable HTTP compatibility issues with stateless bridges and pinned the Go MCP SDK.
body.zh: 修复 MCP Streamable HTTP 与无状态桥接的兼容性问题，并固定 Go MCP SDK。

body.en: Added support for MCP 2026 multi-round interactions and Desktop Apps with sandboxed rendering.
body.zh: 新增对 MCP 2026 多轮交互和桌面 Apps 的支持，并采用沙箱渲染。

body.en: Landed use_capability speed and quality controls, including parallel scheduling, review budgets, and metrics.
body.zh: 落地 use_capability 的速度与质量控制，包括并行调度、审查预算和指标。

body.en: Improved transcript reader transactions to prevent reverse jumps and blank frames during high-speed reasoning.
body.zh: 改进对话阅读滚动事务，防止高速推理时的反向跳跃和空白帧。

body.en: Improved multi-round reasoning timeline rendering and tool timeline alignment.
body.zh: 改进多轮思考时间线渲染和工具时间线对齐。

title.zh: 修复输入框自动高度抖动

body.en: Improved composer autosize to prevent session viewport bounce.
body.zh: 改进输入框自动高度，防止会话视口抖动。

title.en: Aligned model discovery with chat proxy policy
title.zh: 修复自定义供应商刷新正常但对话无响应

body.en: Improved custom provider model discovery to use the same network policy as chat, and made stream failures visible.
body.zh: 改进自定义供应商模型发现以使用与聊天相同的网络策略，并使流失败可见。

title.zh: 修复 Streamable HTTP 兼容性

body.en: Improved MCP Streamable HTTP compatibility with stateless bridges and pinned the Go MCP SDK.
body.zh: 改进 MCP Streamable HTTP 与无状态桥接的兼容性，并固定 Go MCP SDK。

title.zh: serve 与 git 操作安全加固

body.en: Fixed six security-boundary gaps including DNS rebinding, preview confinement, and git clean-filter neutralization.
body.zh: 修复六个安全边界缺口，包括 DNS 重绑定、预览越界读与 git clean 过滤器执行。

title.en: Kept remote project roots out of local topic state
title.zh: 远端项目根不再触碰本地 Topic 元数据

body.en: Fixed a user-visible toast error when opening remote projects on Windows due to invalid path components.
body.zh: 修复在 Windows 上打开远端项目时因无效路径组件导致的用户可见 toast 错误。

title.en: Kept new-session blank row visible in remote groups
title.zh: 远端项目组新会话行稳定显示

body.en: Fixed the new-session blank row flashing and disappearing in remote workspace sidebars.
body.zh: 修复远端工作区侧边栏中新会话行闪烁后消失的问题。

title.en: Kept write path alive across in-place resume
title.zh: 修复 /resume 之后 /new 报写授权缺失

body.en: Fixed a 500 error when creating a new session after an in-place resume due to missing write authority.
body.zh: 修复原地 /resume 后创建新会话时因写授权缺失导致的 500 错误。

summary.en: This release adds MCP 2026 elicitation and stable MCP Apps, improves shell configuration, remote credential security, interface stability, and notification volume control.
summary.zh: 此版本新增 MCP 2026 交互与稳定版 MCP Apps，并改进 Shell 配置、远程凭据安全性、界面稳定性和通知音量控制。

body.en: Host capability profiles, capability negotiation, elicitation, Apps sandboxing, and the cross-version cache contract.
body.zh: 宿主能力分层、能力协商、交互流程、Apps 沙箱与跨版本缓存契约。

title.zh: MCP 2026 交互与稳定版 Apps

body.en: Added MCP 2026-07-28 multi-round-trip form and URL elicitation plus stable MCP Apps 2026-01-26 on Desktop, with explicit capability negotiation and safe cross-version fallbacks.
body.zh: 新增 MCP 2026-07-28 多轮表单及 URL 交互，并在桌面端支持稳定版 MCP Apps 2026-01-26，同时提供显式能力协商与安全的跨版本回退。

title.zh: 安全的跨平台 Shell 支持

body.en: Added a process-level cached shell inventory with deterministic Git for Windows discovery. macOS resolves Bash, native zsh, and POSIX sh; Linux execution remains Bash-only. Git is modeled as an independent capability. Windows repair is manual-only, and macOS/Linux repair guidance provides copy-only commands.
body.zh: 新增进程级缓存的 Shell 清单，并支持确定性的 Git for Windows 发现。macOS 可解析 Bash、原生 zsh 和 POSIX sh；Linux 执行仍仅限 Bash。Git 被建模为独立能力。Windows 修复仅支持手动操作，macOS/Linux 修复指导仅提供复制命令。

body.en: Fixed interface jitter during task execution by keeping reasoning and process disclosures open throughout the active turn lifecycle and using a monotonic height floor to stabilize live footer commits.
body.zh: 修复了任务执行期间的界面抽动问题，通过在整个活动轮次生命周期内保持推理和进程披露展开，并使用单调高度下限稳定实时页脚提交。

title.zh: 安全的远程凭据代理路由

body.en: Remote local proxy routes now keep stable scoped virtual tokens while the desktop holds real provider credentials. Saving, clearing, or deleting credentials synchronously rebuilds or revokes only affected routes, and revoked tokens return HTTP 401.
body.zh: 远程本地代理路由现在保持稳定的作用域虚拟令牌，而桌面端持有真实提供商凭据。保存、清除或删除凭据会同步重建或撤销仅受影响的路由，被撤销的令牌返回 HTTP 401。

body.en: Added a 0–100% notification volume slider in Sound settings with a default of 70%. All notification sounds now route through one master gain, normalizing bundled WAV assets to consistent loudness.
body.zh: 在声音设置中新增 0–100% 的通知音量滑块，默认值为 70%。所有通知声音现在通过一个主增益路由，将内置 WAV 资源标准化为一致的响度。

title.en: Open wizard host suggestions from an explicit arrow
title.zh: 通过明确的箭头打开向导主机建议

body.en: Step 1's host field now shows saved SSH connections through an explicit chevron dropdown, listing all saved connections unfiltered and appending non-22 ports.
body.zh: 第一步的主机字段现在通过明确的箭头下拉菜单显示已保存的 SSH 连接，列出所有已保存的连接且不过滤，并附加非 22 端口。

title.zh: 有界的会话索引重建生命周期

body.en: Manual session index rebuilds are now bounded and awaitable transactions. The sidebar no longer gets stuck in “Organizing history / Rebuilding index” after updates or repairs.
body.zh: 手动会话索引重建现在是有界且可等待的事务。更新或修复后，侧边栏不再卡在“整理历史记录 / 重建索引”状态。

title.zh: 完成待办后自动收起面板

body.en: Completed Todo panels now fade out after a short hold, and restoring a session does not reattach completed batches.
body.zh: 已完成的待办面板现在会在短暂停留后淡出，恢复会话时不会重新附加已完成的批次。

title.en: Stale status races no longer crash
title.zh: 过时的状态竞争不再导致崩溃

body.en: A /status poll losing the race against an SSE-derived frame is now treated as a benign stale snapshot instead of an unhandled rejection crash.
body.zh: 与 SSE 派生帧竞争失败的 /status 轮询现在被视为良性的过时快照，而不再表现为未处理的拒绝崩溃。

body.en: Background history and session indexes now use isolated in-memory SQLite databases, and history flushes finish every registered root before reporting completion, preventing migration collisions and skipped rescans under Windows load.
body.zh: 后台历史记录和会话索引现在使用相互隔离的内存 SQLite 数据库，历史记录排空会在报告完成前处理所有已登记根目录，避免在 Windows 负载下发生迁移冲突或漏掉重新扫描。

title.zh: 等待高度恢复后的挂载覆盖

body.en: Transcript browser replay now waits for stable geometry and preserves extent samples on failure, fixing a race that could expose blank frames in Windows WebView2.
body.zh: 转录浏览器回放现在等待稳定的几何信息并在失败时保留范围样本，修复了 Windows WebView2 中可能暴露空白帧的竞争条件。

title.zh: 绘制前修正空白高度回弹

body.en: Corrects a recoverable blank transcript rebound synchronously from the native scroll delivery before the next visible frame, preventing blank frames.
body.zh: 在下一个可见帧之前，从原生滚动传递同步修正可恢复的空白转录回弹，防止空白帧。

summary.en: This release improves agent conversation flow by ending ordinary turns naturally, removing the need for a synthetic finish tool call.
summary.zh: 此版本改进了代理对话流程，普通回合自然结束，无需调用合成的 finish 工具。

body.en: Updated tool contract documentation reflecting the removal of the finish tool schema.
body.zh: 更新了工具契约文档，反映 finish 工具模式的移除。

body.en: Updated Chinese tool contract documentation reflecting the removal of the finish tool schema.
body.zh: 更新了中文工具契约文档，反映 finish 工具模式的移除。

body.en: Ordinary interactive turns now end when the provider completes a visible assistant response, eliminating the need for a synthetic finish tool call and preventing internal protocol repair errors.
body.zh: 普通交互回合现在在提供者完成可见助手响应时结束，无需调用合成的 finish 工具，并防止内部协议修复错误。

title.zh: 移除强制 finish 工具

body.en: The provider-visible finish schema, mandatory finish enforcement, protocol repair prompt, and user-facing repair failure path have been removed while preserving ask and data-bearing finalizers such as submit_plan.
body.zh: 移除了提供者可见的 finish 模式、强制 finish 执行、协议修复提示和面向用户的修复失败路径，同时保留了 ask 和携带数据的终结器（如 submit_plan）。

body.en: The stable tool schema has been reduced from 4,298 to 4,138 estimated tokens.
body.zh: 稳定工具模式从约 4,298 个 token 减少到 4,138 个 token。

body.en: Fixed an issue where a normal visible answer without a finish call triggered another provider round and surfaced an internal protocol repair error to users.
body.zh: 修复了正常可见回答未调用 finish 时触发额外提供者回合并向用户显示内部协议修复错误的问题。

title.zh: 远程工作区与持久化回合

summary.en: Remote SSH workspaces, durable ordered turns, smoother transcript navigation, and stronger Windows and state-recovery reliability.
summary.zh: 远程 SSH 工作区、持久有序的回合、更流畅的对话导航，以及更可靠的 Windows 与状态恢复体验。

title.zh: 远程 SSH 工作区指南

body.en: Learn how to connect to remote SSH workspaces, manage sessions, and use background turns.
body.zh: 了解如何连接远程 SSH 工作区、管理会话并使用后台回合。

body.en: Command-line interface documentation and configuration options.
body.zh: 命令行界面文档和配置选项。

body.en: Where Reasonix stores configuration and state files.
body.zh: Reasonix 存储配置和状态文件的位置。

body.en: How to migrate existing workspaces and data to the latest version.
body.zh: 如何将现有工作区和数据迁移到最新版本。

body.en: Details on tool schemas and provider interactions.
body.zh: 工具模式和提供程序交互的详细信息。

body.en: Connect remote SSH workspaces, resume exact sessions, and let busy turns continue in the background while you switch sessions.
body.zh: 连接远程 SSH 工作区、精确恢复会话，并在切换会话时让繁忙回合继续在后台运行。

body.en: Ordered turn events now persist across interruptions and restarts, with accepted side effects fenced from replay.
body.zh: 有序的回合事件现在可跨中断与重启持久保存，并防止已接受的副作用被重复执行。

title.zh: 更流畅的对话滚动与导航

body.en: Stabilized scroll-surface ownership and commit navigation only after the destination has painted.
body.zh: 稳定滚动表面所有权，并在目标完成绘制后再提交会话导航。

title.en: Windows taskbar icon and selection rendering
title.zh: Windows 任务栏图标和选区渲染

body.en: Restored the taskbar icon and stabilized transcript selection rendering on Windows.
body.zh: 恢复了任务栏图标并稳定了 Windows 上的对话选区渲染。

body.en: Moved supervised MCP sessions to the official Go SDK and correctly dispatch ACP-supplied host-session servers.
body.zh: 将受管 MCP 会话迁移到官方 Go SDK，并正确调度通过 ACP 提供的宿主会话服务器。

body.en: Moved topic metadata to SQLite for reliability and recovery.
body.zh: 将主题元数据迁移到 SQLite 以提高可靠性和恢复能力。

body.en: Connect remote SSH workspaces, resume exact sessions, and let busy turns continue in the background while you switch sessions.
body.zh: 连接远程 SSH 工作区、精确恢复会话，并在切换会话时让繁忙回合继续在后台运行。

body.en: Ordered turn events now persist across interruptions and restarts, with accepted side effects fenced from replay.
body.zh: 有序的回合事件现在可跨中断与重启持久保存，并防止已接受的副作用被重复执行。

body.en: Archive individual sessions safely from their project-tree group.
body.zh: 现在可以在项目树分组中安全归档单个会话。

title.zh: 更流畅的对话滚动与导航

body.en: Stabilized scroll-surface ownership and commit navigation only after the destination has painted.
body.zh: 稳定滚动表面所有权，并在目标完成绘制后再提交会话导航。

title.zh: 精简 MCP 能力发现

body.en: Capability listing now summarizes each MCP server and keeps full tool catalogs available on demand through inspection.
body.zh: 能力列表现在只摘要展示各 MCP 服务器，完整工具目录仍可按需检查。

body.en: Lowered the minimum compact_ratio to 0.30 for earlier compaction.
body.zh: 将最小 compact_ratio 降低到 0.30，以便更早进行压缩。

title.zh: 更清晰的记忆能力指引

body.en: The capability description now explains when and how to use Reasonix memory tools.
body.zh: 能力说明现在会解释何时以及如何使用 Reasonix 记忆工具。

title.zh: 按客户端拆分的更新日志

body.en: Release notes now separate Desktop and CLI changes for clearer upgrade decisions.
body.zh: 更新日志现在分别展示桌面端与 CLI 变更，便于判断升级影响。

title.en: Windows taskbar icon and selection rendering
title.zh: Windows 任务栏图标和选区渲染

body.en: Restored the taskbar icon and stabilized transcript selection rendering on Windows.
body.zh: 恢复了任务栏图标并稳定了 Windows 上的对话选区渲染。

body.en: Moved supervised MCP sessions to the official Go SDK and correctly dispatch ACP-supplied host-session servers.
body.zh: 将受管 MCP 会话迁移到官方 Go SDK，并正确调度通过 ACP 提供的宿主会话服务器。

body.en: Recovered session projections now publish atomically, avoiding partially updated catalog state.
body.zh: 恢复后的会话投影现在会原子发布，避免目录出现部分更新状态。

body.en: Operational dialogs and menus now use opaque theme surfaces so their content remains readable.
body.zh: 操作对话框和菜单现在使用不透明主题表面，确保内容始终清晰可读。

title.zh: macOS 在 exFAT 上的自动更新

body.en: Fixed self-update on exFAT filesystems.
body.zh: 修复了 exFAT 文件系统上的自动更新。

body.en: Fixed stalled Standard todos by adding a bounded continuation prompt.
body.zh: 通过添加有界的继续提示修复了 Standard 待办停滞。

body.en: Session archiving now tolerates brief local lock handoffs without reporting that the session is still in use.
body.zh: 会话归档现在可容忍短暂的本地锁交接，不会误报会话仍在使用中。

body.en: Moved topic metadata to SQLite for reliability and recovery.
body.zh: 将主题元数据迁移到 SQLite 以提高可靠性和恢复能力。

body.en: Migrated crash-report storage to Firebase with approval, output, and capacity safeguards.
body.zh: 将崩溃报告存储迁移到 Firebase，并加入审批、输出与容量保护。

body.en: Updated gorilla/websocket to 1.5.3.
body.zh: 将 gorilla/websocket 更新到 1.5.3。

title.zh: 现有主题元数据会自动迁移

body.en: Existing workspaces migrate on first access and retain legacy JSON mirrors for sequential downgrade and re-upgrade; no manual action is required.
body.zh: 现有工作区会在首次访问时迁移，并保留旧版 JSON 镜像以支持顺序降级与再次升级；无需手动操作。

body.en: Workspaces first created in v1.32.0 keep topic metadata only in SQLite. A direct downgrade may recover titles from session metadata but cannot guarantee creation timestamps or auto-title stages. Do not run old and new Reasonix versions against the same workspace concurrently.
body.zh: 在 v1.32.0 中首次创建的工作区仅在 SQLite 中保存主题元数据。直接降级时可从会话元数据恢复标题，但无法保证创建时间或自动标题阶段完整恢复。请勿让新旧 Reasonix 版本同时写入同一工作区。

title.zh: 桌面端稳定性与性能改进

summary.en: This release fixes several desktop issues including corrupted session metadata recovery, background job notifications, provider deletion, and transcript scrolling. It also improves performance by retiring an expensive metrics rollup.
summary.zh: 此版本修复了多个桌面端问题，包括损坏的会话元数据恢复、后台任务通知、模型服务删除和会话滚动。同时通过移除高成本的指标汇总提升了性能。

body.en: Learn how goal enforcement works in Reasonix.
body.zh: 了解 Reasonix 中目标执行的工作原理。

body.en: Comprehensive guide to using Reasonix.
body.zh: 使用 Reasonix 的综合指南。

body.en: Comprehensive guide to using Reasonix in Chinese.
body.zh: 使用 Reasonix 的中文综合指南。

title.zh: 从损坏的会话元数据中恢复

body.en: Sessions with all-zero or whitespace-only metadata files now rebuild automatically instead of blocking saves and tab closing.
body.zh: 元数据文件全零或仅含空白的会话现在会自动重建，不再阻止保存和关闭标签页。

title.zh: 更清晰的后台任务通知

body.en: Quiet long-running background jobs are no longer reported as stalled; the notice now states the job is still running and explains how to adjust the warning threshold.
body.zh: 安静运行的后台任务不再被报告为“卡住”；通知现在说明任务仍在运行，并解释如何调整警告阈值。

title.zh: 删除已配置的默认模型服务

body.en: You can now remove a configured custom provider even when it is the current default; the backend safely retargets references.
body.zh: 现在即使模型服务是当前默认值，也可以删除已配置的自定义服务；后端会安全地重新定向引用。

body.en: Fixed scroll bouncing, flickering, and inability to reach the bottom in long transcripts, especially during streaming output.
body.zh: 修复了长会话中滚动跳动、闪烁和无法到达底部的问题，尤其是在流式输出期间。

body.en: Retired an expensive metrics rollup that consumed the entire database read budget, improving overall performance.
body.zh: 移除了消耗全部数据库读取预算的高成本指标汇总，提升了整体性能。

title.en: Better math rendering in desktop and CLI
title.zh: 桌面端和 CLI 中更好的数学渲染

body.en: Fixed boxed formula rendering in WKWebView and added support for more LaTeX commands in the CLI renderer.
body.zh: 修复了 WKWebView 中盒装公式的渲染，并在 CLI 渲染器中添加了对更多 LaTeX 命令的支持。

body.en: Fixed sidebar conversation reordering when switching sessions by preserving known activity timestamps.
body.zh: 通过保留已知的活动时间戳，修复了切换会话时侧栏对话重新排序的问题。

title.zh: 停止会话目录反复重新索引

body.en: Fixed a loop where idle sessions repeatedly entered indexing/repair state, making deletion appear unavailable.
body.zh: 修复了空闲会话反复进入索引/修复状态导致删除不可用的循环。

title.zh: OpenCode Go 分组原子删除

body.en: Fixed removal of the OpenCode Go provider card by supporting atomic deletion of its custom provider routes.
body.zh: 通过支持原子删除其自定义服务路由，修复了 OpenCode Go 服务卡片的移除问题。

body.en: Standard and Delivery turns no longer launch hidden readiness follow-up turns, reducing extra thinking rounds and provider requests.
body.zh: 标准回合和交付回合不再启动隐藏的收尾后续回合，减少了额外的思考轮次和服务请求。

title.en: DeepSeek Vision Support and Smoother Session Switching
title.zh: DeepSeek 视觉支持与更流畅的会话切换

summary.en: This release adds official DeepSeek vision model support for image inputs, cleans up the web search sources panel, and fixes transcript flicker during session switches.
summary.zh: 此版本新增官方 DeepSeek 视觉模型图像输入支持，清理了网络搜索来源面板，并修复了切换会话时的 transcript 闪烁问题。

body.en: Learn about billing for DeepSeek models, including the new vision SKU.
body.zh: 了解 DeepSeek 模型的计费方式，包括新的视觉 SKU。

body.en: Find configuration file locations for DeepSeek Reasonix.
body.zh: 查找 DeepSeek Reasonix 的配置文件位置。

body.en: Get started with DeepSeek Reasonix.
body.zh: 开始使用 DeepSeek Reasonix。

body.en: Technical specification for DeepSeek Reasonix.
body.zh: DeepSeek Reasonix 的技术规范。

title.zh: 官方 DeepSeek 视觉模型支持

body.en: Added the official DeepSeek vision SKU `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` as a third catalog option. Image payloads are enabled only when this SKU is selected, with support for inline base64, public URLs, and Files API file IDs. Local images over 32 MiB are uploaded via the Files API.
body.zh: 新增官方 DeepSeek 视觉 SKU `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 作为第三个目录选项。仅在选择此 SKU 时启用图像负载，支持内联 base64、公共 URL 和 Files API 文件 ID。超过 32 MiB 的本地图像通过 Files API 上传。

title.zh: 更简洁的网络搜索来源面板

body.en: Replaced the expanded raw URL dump with a collapsed, accessible Sources panel. Display-only sources are normalized: HTTP(S) only, tracking parameters stripped, redirects unwrapped, invalid or title-less hits hidden, and canonical URLs deduplicated.
body.zh: 将展开的原始 URL 转储替换为可折叠、无障碍的 Sources 面板。仅显示规范化来源：仅 HTTP(S)，去除跟踪参数，解开重定向，隐藏无效或无标题的命中，并对规范 URL 去重。

title.en: No More Transcript Flicker on Session Switch
title.zh: 切换会话时不再出现 transcript 闪烁

body.en: Switching between desktop sessions no longer exposes an empty transcript while history loads. The last stable transcript remains visible behind an inert loading overlay and is replaced only after the target surface is ready.
body.zh: 在桌面会话之间切换时，不再在历史记录加载期间显示空白 transcript。最后一个稳定的 transcript 保持可见，并带有惰性加载覆盖层，仅在目标表面就绪后才替换。

body.en: Added `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` as a third catalog SKU with image input support.
body.zh: 新增 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 作为第三个目录 SKU，支持图像输入。

body.en: Collapsed and normalized the web search sources display.
body.zh: 折叠并规范化网络搜索来源显示。

title.zh: 切换会话时的 transcript 闪烁

body.en: Prevented empty transcript flash during session switches.
body.zh: 防止切换会话时出现空白 transcript 闪烁。

title.en: Typecheck Errors in Transcript Diagnostics Tests
title.zh: transcript 诊断测试中的类型检查错误

body.en: Fixed typecheck errors in test files by using ES2022-compatible indexing and adding missing fixture fields.
body.zh: 通过使用 ES2022 兼容的索引并添加缺失的 fixture 字段，修复了测试文件中的类型检查错误。

title.en: Desktop stability and provider setup improvements
title.zh: 桌面稳定性与提供商配置改进

summary.en: This release fixes transcript scrolling issues on Windows and simplifies OpenCode Go setup with a one-key configuration path.
summary.zh: 此版本修复了 Windows 上会话滚动问题，并通过一键配置路径简化了 OpenCode Go 的设置。

title.zh: Windows 上稳定的会话滚动

body.en: Fixed upward-scroll flashback in long sessions by unifying row geometry, measurement caching, and snapshot validation. Added frontend diagnostics for test builds and Settings → Diagnostics.
body.zh: 通过统一行几何、测量缓存和快照验证，修复了长会话中向上滚动闪回的问题。为测试构建和设置 → 诊断添加了前端诊断功能。

title.zh: 简化 OpenCode Go 配置

body.en: OpenCode Go now shares the featured-provider level with DeepSeek, offering a one-key setup with safe base routes and route-aware output budgets.
body.zh: OpenCode Go 现在与 DeepSeek 共享特色提供商级别，提供一键设置，包含安全基础路由和路由感知的输出预算。

body.en: Added a featured-provider setup flow for DeepSeek and OpenCode Go, with one API key and safe base routes. Legacy, Anthropic, Responses, and DeepSeek search routes remain available.
body.zh: 为 DeepSeek 和 OpenCode Go 添加了特色提供商设置流程，只需一个 API 密钥和安全基础路由。旧版、Anthropic、Responses 和 DeepSeek 搜索路由仍然可用。

body.en: Added route/model-aware output budgets with one safe retry when a provider reports a lower completion limit. Streaming requests do not retry after the first output event.
body.zh: 添加了路由/模型感知的输出预算，当提供商报告较低的完成限制时进行一次安全重试。流式请求在第一个输出事件后不会重试。

body.en: Fixed upward-scroll flashback by adding state-aware row geometry, session-scoped LRU measurement caching, snapshot validation, and disabling browser scroll anchoring during manual scrolling.
body.zh: 通过添加状态感知的行几何、会话范围的 LRU 测量缓存、快照验证以及在手动滚动期间禁用浏览器滚动锚定，修复了向上滚动闪回问题。

body.en: Added a sanitized frontend diagnostics recorder for test builds and Settings → Diagnostics, without exporting text, paths, stable IDs, or session identifiers.
body.zh: 为测试构建和设置 → 诊断添加了经过清理的前端诊断记录器，不导出文本、路径、稳定 ID 或会话标识符。

title.en: Desktop stability, session recovery, and provider routing fixes
title.zh: 桌面端稳定性、会话恢复与提供商路由修复

summary.en: This patch release improves desktop session recovery, scroll behavior, composer input, and provider routing. It also fixes QQ Bot gateway negotiation and web search result display.
summary.zh: 此补丁版本改进了桌面端会话恢复、滚动行为、输入框和提供商路由，并修复了 QQ Bot 网关协商和 Web 搜索结果显示。

body.en: Learn where Reasonix stores configuration and session data.
body.zh: 了解 Reasonix 存储配置和会话数据的位置。

body.en: Chinese guide to configuration paths.
body.zh: 配置路径的中文指南。

body.en: Chinese guide to goal enforcement.
body.zh: 目标执行的中文指南。

body.en: General usage guide.
body.zh: 通用使用指南。

body.en: Chinese usage guide.
body.zh: 中文使用指南。

body.en: Details on session catalog and recovery.
body.zh: 会话目录与恢复的详细信息。

body.en: Chinese details on session catalog and recovery.
body.zh: 会话目录与恢复的中文详细信息。

title.en: Session sidebar no longer loses conversations after upgrade
title.zh: 升级后会话侧栏不再丢失对话

body.en: Rebuilds the session index from authoritative files and shows recovery-only sessions as a single row.
body.zh: 从权威文件重建会话索引，并将仅恢复会话显示为单行。

title.en: Stable transcript scrolling and tail ownership
title.zh: 稳定的对话滚动与尾部归属

body.en: Separates tail-follow, recovery, and selection signals to prevent scroll jumps while reading.
body.zh: 分离尾部跟随、恢复和选择信号，防止阅读时滚动跳动。

title.en: IME composition and autosize overflow fixed
title.zh: 修复输入法组合与自适应高度溢出

body.en: Preserves IME composition text and shows scrollbar for long drafts.
body.zh: 保留输入法组合文本，并为长草稿显示滚动条。

title.en: OpenCode Go recommended preset with route-safe routing
title.zh: OpenCode Go 推荐预设与路由安全

body.en: One-click preset installs Chat, Anthropic Messages, and Responses providers with protocol-safe model routing.
body.zh: 一键预设安装 Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 Responses 提供商，并实现协议安全的模型路由。

title.zh: QQ Bot 网关意图自动协商

body.en: Automatically switches between private and public guild intents to avoid connection failures.
body.zh: 自动在私域和公域意图之间切换，避免连接失败。

title.en: Web search result deltas now displayed
title.zh: Web 搜索增量结果现已显示

body.en: Decodes and surfaces Anthropic web-search result delta events.
body.zh: 解码并显示 Anthropic Web 搜索增量结果事件。

body.en: Adds a one-click preset for Chat, Anthropic Messages, and Responses providers with route-safe model catalogs.
body.zh: 为 Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 Responses 提供商添加一键预设，并具有路由安全的模型目录。

body.en: Adds configuration for history search index size limits and eviction.
body.zh: 添加历史搜索索引大小限制和淘汰的配置。

body.en: Fuses session digest into decode path to reduce startup work.
body.zh: 将会话摘要融合到解码路径，减少启动工作。

body.en: Allows renaming catalog-only topics and reconciles stale activity indicators.
body.zh: 允许重命名仅目录主题，并协调过时的活动指示器。

body.en: Folds redundant recovery copies and adds bounded sweeping to trash.
body.zh: 折叠冗余恢复副本，并添加有界清理到回收站。

body.en: Deterministic streaming fence styling and local Mermaid pan/zoom.
body.zh: 确定性的流式代码块样式和本地 Mermaid 平移/缩放。

body.en: Removes leftover rail column and redundant breadcrumbs.
body.zh: 移除残留的轨道列和冗余面包屑。

title.en: Bounded continuation for Standard write tasks
title.zh: Standard 写任务的有界自动续跑

body.en: Prevents infinite continuation and shows a recoverable card when bounded continuation stops.
body.zh: 防止无限续跑，并在有界续跑停止时显示可恢复卡片。

body.en: Rebuilds session index from authoritative files and shows recovery-only sessions.
body.zh: 从权威文件重建会话索引，并显示仅恢复会话。

body.en: Decodes and surfaces result delta events.
body.zh: 解码并显示增量结果事件。

body.en: Auto-negotiates intents to support both private and public guild bots.
body.zh: 自动协商意图，支持私域和公域机器人。

title.zh: 输入法组合与自适应高度溢出

body.en: Preserves IME text and shows scrollbar for long drafts.
body.zh: 保留输入法文本，并为长草稿显示滚动条。

title.en: Automation workspace, reliable scheduling, and workspace refinements
title.zh: 自动化工作区、可靠调度与工作区优化

summary.en: This release introduces a dedicated Automation workspace with hardened scheduled-task execution, refines workspace panel sizing and state management, fixes incomplete sidebar session indexing and a transient jump-bottom flash when the composer wraps, and updates issue reporting channels.
summary.zh: 此版本引入了专用的自动化工作区并强化了计划任务执行，优化了工作区面板尺寸与状态管理，修复了侧栏会话索引不完整和输入框折行时短暂闪现“回到底部”的问题，并更新了问题报告渠道。

body.en: For details on supported version lines and reporting methods, see the migration guide.
body.zh: 有关支持的版本线和报告方式的详细信息，请参阅迁移指南。

body.en: For details on supported version lines and reporting methods, see the migration guide.
body.zh: 有关支持的版本线和报告方式的详细信息，请参阅迁移指南。

title.zh: 自动化工作区与可靠调度

body.en: Heartbeat is upgraded to a page-level Automation workspace with grouped/flat task lists, search and filters, an editable detail pane, run history, and conversation navigation. Scheduling supports interval, calendar-cycle, cron, and time-window plans with lossless conversion guards and localized next-run descriptions. Recommendation templates open as disabled ask drafts for review before enabling.
body.zh: Heartbeat 现已升级为页面级自动化工作区，提供分组/平铺任务列表、搜索与筛选、可编辑详情面板、运行历史和会话导航。调度支持间隔、日历周期、cron 和时间窗口计划，并具备无损转换保护和本地化的下次运行描述。推荐模板以禁用的 ask 草稿形式打开，供用户在启用前审查。

title.en: Refined workspace panel sizing and state management
title.zh: 优化工作区面板宽度与状态管理

body.en: The chat panel can now shrink to 400px, topicbar actions collapse into a More menu, panel widths are unified and remembered per project, and workspace panel scrolling and breadcrumbs are improved.
body.zh: 聊天面板现在可缩小至 400px，主题栏操作折叠进“更多”菜单，面板宽度统一并按项目记忆，工作区面板的滚动和面包屑也得到优化。

title.zh: 长草稿可扩展已调整大小的输入框

body.en: A manually resized composer now treats its saved height as a minimum, grows to reveal longer drafts, returns to that baseline when content shrinks, and scrolls internally only at the viewport-aware limit.
body.zh: 手动调整过的输入框现在将已保存高度作为最小值；长草稿会继续展开，内容缩短后回到该基线，并仅在达到视口上限时启用内部滚动。

title.zh: 修复侧栏会话索引不完整的问题

body.en: Detects and repairs persisted ready directory projections when live session row counts don't match completed scan totals, reconciling missing session and topic rows from authoritative JSONL files.
body.zh: 检测并修复持久化的就绪目录投影，当实时会话行数与已完成扫描总数不匹配时，从权威 JSONL 文件协调缺失的会话和主题行。

title.en: Composer wrapping no longer flashes jump-bottom
title.zh: 输入框折行时不再闪现“回到底部”

body.en: When a growing composer wraps and shrinks the transcript viewport, tail-follow now pins the native transcript tail synchronously so jump-bottom no longer flashes for a frame. Manual-reading and content-collapse behavior remain unchanged.
body.zh: 当输入框内容增长并折行、导致对话视口缩小时，尾部跟随会同步固定原生对话尾部，避免“回到底部”按钮闪现一帧，同时保持手动阅读和内容收缩时的原有行为。

body.en: The compact workbench sidebar's Pinned section heading now includes a decorative pin icon and dedicated non-interactive styles, visually aligned with project folders.
body.zh: 紧凑型工作台侧栏的“置顶”区域标题现在包含装饰性图钉图标和专用的非交互样式，与项目文件夹保持视觉对齐。

body.en: Heartbeat is upgraded to a page-level Automation workspace with grouped/flat task lists, search and status/project filters, an editable detail pane, persisted split sizing, run history, and conversation navigation.
body.zh: Heartbeat 现已升级为页面级自动化工作区，提供分组/平铺任务列表、搜索与状态/项目筛选、可编辑详情面板、持久化分割尺寸、运行历史和会话导航。

body.en: Supports interval, calendar-cycle, cron, and time-window schedules with lossless conversion guards and localized next-run descriptions.
body.zh: 支持间隔、日历周期、cron 和时间窗口计划，并具备无损转换保护和本地化的下次运行描述。

title.zh: 推荐模板以草稿形式打开

body.en: Recommendation templates open as disabled ask drafts so users can review the prompt, scope, and permissions before enabling execution.
body.zh: 推荐模板以禁用的 ask 草稿形式打开，供用户在启用执行前审查提示词、范围和权限。

title.zh: 工作区面板尺寸与状态

body.en: Chat panel can shrink to 400px, topicbar actions collapse into a More menu, panel widths are unified and remembered per project, and workspace panel scrolling and breadcrumbs are improved.
body.zh: 聊天面板可缩小至 400px，主题栏操作折叠进“更多”菜单，面板宽度统一并按项目记忆，工作区面板的滚动和面包屑也得到优化。

title.zh: 已调整大小的输入框随内容增长

body.en: Manually resized composers grow beyond their saved minimum for longer drafts, shrink back with shorter content, and preserve the existing viewport-aware maximum.
body.zh: 手动调整过的输入框会在长草稿下超过已保存的最小高度，内容缩短后回落，并继续遵守现有的视口高度上限。

body.en: The compact workbench sidebar's Pinned section heading now includes a decorative pin icon and dedicated non-interactive styles.
body.zh: 紧凑型工作台侧栏的“置顶”区域标题现在包含装饰性图钉图标和专用的非交互样式。

body.en: Issue forms now list v2 and v3 Studio version lines, with v1 removed and automatic labeling updated.
body.zh: 问题表单现在列出 v2 和 v3 Studio 版本线，移除了 v1 并更新了自动标签。

title.en: Jump-bottom flash while the composer wraps
title.zh: 输入框折行时闪现“回到底部”

body.en: Pins the transcript tail synchronously while tail-follow owns the viewport, preventing a one-frame jump-bottom flash when a growing composer wraps and reduces the visible transcript height.
body.zh: 当尾部跟随仍控制视口时同步固定对话尾部，避免输入框内容增长并折行、压缩可见对话高度时短暂闪现“回到底部”按钮。

body.en: Detects and repairs persisted ready directory projections when live session row counts don't match completed scan totals, reconciling missing session and topic rows from authoritative JSONL files.
body.zh: 检测并修复持久化的就绪目录投影，当实时会话行数与已完成扫描总数不匹配时，从权威 JSONL 文件协调缺失的会话和主题行。

summary.en: Improved write conflict handling, added DingTalk bot adapter, and fixed multiple desktop UI issues for smoother long-session navigation and streaming.
summary.zh: 改进写入冲突处理，新增钉钉机器人适配器，并修复多项桌面端 UI 问题，提升长会话导航与流式体验。

body.en: Command-line usage and configuration reference.
body.zh: 命令行使用与配置参考。

body.en: Chinese reference for command-line usage and configuration.
body.zh: 命令行使用与配置的中文参考。

body.en: Details on session ownership and write conflict handling.
body.zh: 会话所有权与写入冲突处理详情。

body.en: Chinese details on session ownership and write conflict handling.
body.zh: 会话所有权与写入冲突处理的中文详情。

body.en: Reasonix technical specification.
body.zh: Reasonix 技术规范。

body.en: Chinese version of the Reasonix technical specification.
body.zh: Reasonix 技术规范的中文版本。

body.en: Guide to subagent profile configuration.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件指南。

body.en: Chinese guide to subagent profile configuration.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件的中文指南。

title.zh: 更智能的写入冲突检测

body.en: Write conflicts are now determined by actual file paths rather than treating the entire workspace as exclusive, allowing concurrent writes to different files while still serializing writes to the same file.
body.zh: 写入冲突现在按实际文件路径判定，不再将整个工作区视为独占，允许不同文件的并发写入，同时仍对同一文件的写入进行串行化。

body.en: Added a DingTalk Stream adapter with WebSocket long connections, @mention gating, message deduplication, and session webhook replies.
body.zh: 新增钉钉 Stream 适配器，支持 WebSocket 长连接、@提及门控、消息去重和会话 webhook 回复。

body.en: Fixed Windows session geometry issues, height rebounds, and history navigation problems to keep long conversations smooth and fully navigable.
body.zh: 修复 Windows 会话几何问题、高度回弹和历史导航问题，使长对话保持流畅且完全可导航。

body.en: Added a DingTalk Stream adapter with WebSocket long connections, @mention gating, message deduplication, and session webhook replies.
body.zh: 新增钉钉 Stream 适配器，支持 WebSocket 长连接、@提及门控、消息去重和会话 webhook 回复。

title.zh: 更智能的写入冲突检测

body.en: Write conflicts are now determined by actual file paths rather than treating the entire workspace as exclusive, allowing concurrent writes to different files while still serializing writes to the same file.
body.zh: 写入冲突现在按实际文件路径判定，不再将整个工作区视为独占，允许不同文件的并发写入，同时仍对同一文件的写入进行串行化。

title.en: Clearer disabled style for immutable provider names
title.zh: 供应商名称不可修改时提供更直观的置灰与提示样式

body.en: When editing an existing custom provider, the provider name input is now visually disabled with a localized hint explaining that changing the name is not supported yet.
body.zh: 编辑已添加的自定义供应商时，供应商名称输入框现在会显示为禁用状态，并带有本地化提示，说明暂不支持修改名称。

title.zh: 分组标题字号略大于普通会话标题

body.en: Session-group headers now use a slightly larger font than session titles, improving hierarchy and clickable area.
body.zh: 会话分组标题现在使用略大于会话标题的字号，改善层级和可点击区域。

title.zh: 本轮验证打开改动面板摘要

body.en: Completion notices now include a functional Turn verification button that opens the changed dock and scrolls to the turn-verification summary.
body.zh: 完成通知现在包含可用的“本轮验证”按钮，打开改动面板并滚动到本轮验证摘要。

title.en: Scratch writes no longer trigger delivery attention card
title.zh: 探路写入不再触发交付警告卡

body.en: Writes to scratch directories like /tmp no longer count as delivery work, preventing false warnings about unverified project changes.
body.zh: 写入 /tmp 等临时目录不再计为交付工作，避免出现关于未验证项目更改的错误警告。

title.zh: 保持完整历史对话可导航

body.en: Historical conversations are now fully navigable, with automatic loading of older pages and synchronized active question markers.
body.zh: 历史对话现在完全可导航，旧页面自动加载，活动问题标记与滚动同步。

title.en: Preserve reader intent across extent rebounds
title.zh: 修复会话高度回弹导致的反向跳动

body.en: Prevented Windows WebView2 transcript extent rebounds from reversing active reader gestures by multiple screens.
body.zh: 防止 Windows WebView2 会话高度回弹导致活动阅读手势反向跳动多个屏幕。

title.zh: 修复 Windows 长会话滚动跳变与空白

body.en: Fixed visible flashes, jumps, and viewport instability in long transcripts on Windows by correcting stale row geometry handling.
body.zh: 通过纠正过时的行几何处理，修复 Windows 长会话中的可见闪烁、跳动和视口不稳定问题。

title.en: Fall back to text paste when clipboard holds no image
title.zh: 修复剪贴板无图片时 Ctrl+V 拦截纯文本粘贴

body.en: Ctrl+V now falls back to text paste when the clipboard contains no image, instead of showing an error notice.
body.zh: 当剪贴板中没有图片时，Ctrl+V 现在会回退到文本粘贴，而不是显示错误通知。

title.en: Fix large file preview height and row gaps
title.zh: 修复文件预览限高与行间距空白

body.en: Fixed code preview layout issues in the desktop file panel, including incorrect row gaps and insufficient height for large files.
body.zh: 修复桌面文件面板中代码预览的布局问题，包括行间距错误和大文件高度不足。

title.en: Flush stream deltas on a stall timer
title.zh: 修复思考中卡住、停止后才显示内容

body.en: Added a fallback stall timer to flush stream deltas when requestAnimationFrame pauses, preventing frozen 'thinking...' states.
body.zh: 添加备用停滞计时器，在 requestAnimationFrame 暂停时刷新流增量，防止出现卡在“思考中”的状态。

title.zh: 桌面端可靠性与工作流修复

summary.en: This release makes the configured default model apply after restart and to new sessions, unblocks todo progress updates, and fixes Windows image preview controls, reduced-motion transcript flicker, and duplicate pinned conversations.
summary.zh: 此版本让设置的默认模型在重启后和新会话中正确生效，解除待办进度更新阻塞，并修复 Windows 图片预览窗口按钮、减少动态效果时的对话区闪烁以及置顶对话重复显示问题。

title.en: Default model now applies after restart and to new sessions
title.zh: 默认模型在重启和新会话中正确生效

body.en: Changing the default model in Settings now persists across restart and applies when starting or reusing a blank session, while existing conversations keep their saved model.
body.zh: 在设置中更改默认模型后，重启应用以及新建或复用空白会话都会使用该模型，已有会话仍保留各自保存的模型。

title.en: Todo progress updates no longer stall
title.zh: 待办进度更新不再卡住

body.en: The todo panel now updates progress without requiring a prior complete_step, avoiding deadlocks in plan mode and normal execution.
body.zh: 待办面板现在无需先执行 complete_step 即可更新进度，避免在计划模式和普通执行中出现死锁。

title.en: Windows image preview hides window controls
title.zh: Windows 图片预览隐藏窗口控制按钮

body.en: The image viewer now hides custom minimize, maximize, and close controls on Windows, eliminating duplicate close actions.
body.zh: 图片查看器现在在 Windows 上隐藏自定义的最小化、最大化和关闭按钮，消除了重复的关闭操作。

title.zh: 减少动态效果时对话区闪烁问题已解决

body.en: Fixed the scroll oscillation loop that occurred when Windows system animations were disabled, ensuring the transcript stays stable and the jump-to-bottom button works reliably.
body.zh: 修复了 Windows 关闭系统动画时出现的滚动振荡循环，确保对话区正确稳定，跳到底部按钮可靠工作。

title.en: Pinned conversations no longer duplicate in project tree
title.zh: 置顶对话不再在项目树中重复显示

body.en: Pinned conversations now appear only once in the sidebar, without being repeated in their original folder.
body.zh: 置顶对话现在在侧边栏中只显示一次，不会在其原始文件夹中再次出现。

title.en: Default model persists and seeds new sessions
title.zh: 默认模型持久化并应用到新会话

body.en: The desktop persists the selected default to the current session sidecar and applies it after New Session rotation or when reusing a blank tab.
body.zh: 桌面端会把所选默认模型持久化到当前会话 sidecar，并在新会话轮换或复用空白标签页时应用该模型。

title.en: Todo progress updates no longer stall
title.zh: 待办进度更新不再卡住

body.en: todo_write can now mark items completed in any workflow phase without a prior complete_step, fixing deadlocks in plan mode and normal execution.
body.zh: todo_write 现在可以在任何工作流阶段标记项目完成，无需先执行 complete_step，修复了计划模式和普通执行中的死锁。

title.en: Windows image preview hides window controls
title.zh: Windows 图片预览隐藏窗口控制按钮

body.en: The image viewer hides custom window controls on Windows, removing the duplicate close button.
body.zh: 图片查看器在 Windows 上隐藏自定义窗口控制按钮，移除了重复的关闭按钮。

title.zh: 减少动态效果时对话区闪烁问题已解决

body.en: Fixed scroll oscillation when Windows system animations are disabled, ensuring the transcript position remains stable.
body.zh: 修复了 Windows 关闭系统动画时的滚动振荡，确保对话区位置稳定。

title.en: Pinned conversations no longer duplicate in project tree
title.zh: 置顶对话不再在项目树中重复显示

body.en: Pinned conversations are deduplicated and appear only once in the sidebar.
body.zh: 置顶对话已去重，在侧边栏中只显示一次。

summary.en: This release restores delivery-grade session quality floors, bounds background job lease retention, pins official DeepSeek-V4-Pro to the DSH persona, completes StepFun provider presets, and fixes several desktop transcript navigation issues.
summary.zh: 此版本恢复了交付级会话质量底线，限制了后台任务租约保留时间，为官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 固定 DSH 人设，补全了阶跃星辰提供商预设，并修复了多个桌面端会话记录导航问题。

body.en: Updated to document the official DeepSeek-V4-Pro auto reasoning language and first-line persona.
body.zh: 更新以记录官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的自动推理语言和首行人设。

body.en: Updated to document the official DeepSeek-V4-Pro auto reasoning language and first-line persona.
body.zh: 更新以记录官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的自动推理语言和首行人设。

body.en: The standard and delivery roles return as session quality floors. Delivery sessions now enforce sticky completion gates: strict full verification after writes, plus final readiness checks.
body.zh: 标准和交付角色作为会话质量底线回归。交付会话现在强制执行粘性完成门槛：写入后进行严格完整验证，以及最终就绪检查。

title.zh: 后台任务租约保留有界

body.en: Resident background services no longer hold the workspace write lease indefinitely. The lease is released after a 30-second grace period following the final agent run.
body.zh: 常驻后台服务不再无限期持有工作区写入租约。在最终代理运行结束后的 30 秒宽限期后，租约将被释放。

title.zh: 官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 人设固定

body.en: Official DeepSeek-V4-Pro now automatically prepends the DeepSeek Harness minimal-mode persona as the first system-prompt paragraph, with reasoning language pinned to English.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 现在自动将 DeepSeek Harness 最小模式人设作为系统提示的第一段前置，并将推理语言固定为英语。

title.en: StepFun provider URL canonicalization and preset completion
title.zh: 阶跃星辰提供商 URL 规范化与预设补全

body.en: StepFun custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints are now canonicalized to prevent 404 errors, and the preset matrix is completed for all channel and protocol combinations.
body.zh: 阶跃星辰自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点现已规范化以防止 404 错误，并补全了所有渠道和协议组合的预设矩阵。

title.zh: 桌面端会话记录导航修复

body.en: Question navigation and rewind now land on the selected question instead of jumping to the transcript tail. Repeated tail writes during scroll delivery are also prevented.
body.zh: 问题导航和回退现在会落在所选问题上，而不是跳到会话记录末尾。同时防止了滚动交付期间重复的尾部写入。

body.en: Restores standard and delivery roles as session quality floors, with delivery enforcing sticky completion gates.
body.zh: 恢复标准和交付角色作为会话质量底线，交付角色强制执行粘性完成门槛。

body.en: Automatically prepends the DSH minimal-mode persona and pins reasoning language to English for official DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
body.zh: 为官方 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 自动前置 DSH 最小模式人设，并将推理语言固定为英语。

title.zh: 阶跃星辰预设矩阵补全

body.en: Adds missing StepFun presets for all channel and protocol combinations.
body.zh: 为所有渠道和协议组合添加缺失的阶跃星辰预设。

title.zh: 阶跃星辰 URL 规范化

body.en: Canonicalizes known official StepFun step_plan URLs to prevent chat/probe endpoint mismatch.
body.zh: 规范化已知的官方阶跃星辰 step_plan URL，防止聊天/探测端点不匹配。

title.zh: 后台任务租约保留有界

body.en: Releases workspace write lease after a 30-second grace period following the final agent run, even if background jobs continue.
body.zh: 在最终代理运行结束后的 30 秒宽限期后释放工作区写入租约，即使后台任务仍在继续。

body.en: Fixes question navigator and rewind jumping to transcript tail instead of selected question.
body.zh: 修复问题导航器和回退跳到会话记录末尾而不是所选问题的问题。

title.en: Repeated tail writes during scroll delivery
title.zh: 滚动交付期间重复尾部写入

body.en: Prevents repeated tail-follow writes when multiple non-bottom deliveries occur for one physical displacement.
body.zh: 防止在一次物理位移产生多个非底部交付时重复进行尾部跟随写入。

summary.en: This release improves transcript navigation reliability, adds ordered batch sign-offs with anchor safety, and hardens desktop window lifecycle recovery.
summary.zh: 此版本提高了会话导航的可靠性，新增按序批量签收与锚点安全门禁，并加固了桌面窗口生命周期恢复。

body.en: Learn about ordered batch sign-offs and other features.
body.zh: 了解按序批量签收及其他功能。

body.en: Chinese version of the user guide.
body.zh: 用户指南的中文版本。

title.en: Ordered batch sign-offs with anchor safety
title.zh: 按序批量签收与锚点安全门禁

body.en: Multiple evidence-backed complete_step calls can now be made in one provider tool-call round while preserving canonical Todo ordering, sequential host advancement, rejection semantics, and idempotency. Host-only model-visible text observations and closed-interval SHA-256 fingerprints for delete_range are added, with safe handling of same-batch reads, partial windows, changed targets, and invalid anchors.
body.zh: 现在可以在一个提供方工具调用回合中进行多个有证据支持的 complete_step 调用，同时保持规范的 Todo 顺序、顺序主机推进、拒绝语义和幂等性。为 delete_range 添加了仅主机可见的模型文本观察和闭区间 SHA-256 指纹，并安全处理同批次读取、部分窗口、更改目标和无效锚点。

title.en: Reliable transcript navigation and scroll ownership
title.zh: 可靠的会话导航与滚动所有权

body.en: Fixed stale transcript navigation, preserved upward reader intent, converged transcript tail on native geometry, and fixed question navigation clicks. Cross-session navigation now hides source content synchronously and shows a localized loading surface.
body.zh: 修复了过期的会话导航，保留了向上阅读意图，使会话尾部收敛于原生几何，并修复了问题导航点击。跨会话导航现在同步隐藏源内容并显示本地化的加载界面。

title.zh: 桌面窗口生命周期恢复加固

body.en: Coordinated main-window presentation through one App-owned lifecycle path, gated Linux close-to-background on live StatusNotifier registration, and treated Wayland activation as compositor acknowledgement.
body.zh: 通过一个 App 拥有的生命周期路径协调主窗口呈现，在实时 StatusNotifier 注册上限制 Linux 关闭到后台，并将 Wayland 激活视为合成器确认。

title.en: Provider Responses tool turns without reasoning recovered
title.zh: 修复 Responses 缺少推理的工具回合

body.en: Recovered DeepSeek and MiMo Responses tool turns when the provider omits an optional reasoning item, with effort-aware replay requirements.
body.zh: 当提供方省略可选推理项时，恢复了 DeepSeek 和 MiMo Responses 工具回合，并具有努力感知的重放要求。

title.zh: 工具结果缓存前缀稳定性

body.en: Kept each provider-visible tool result on the stable persisted Content representation, bounded to 32 KiB, while retaining the complete local value in RawContent.
body.zh: 将每个提供方可见的工具结果保持在稳定的持久化 Content 表示上，限制为 32 KiB，同时在 RawContent 中保留完整的本地值。

title.zh: macOS 工作区监听使用 FSEvents

body.en: Replaced the macOS fsnotify/kqueue workspace backend with Apple FSEvents, using one native stream per workspace watch root instead of descriptors that grow with the directory tree.
body.zh: 用 Apple FSEvents 替换了 macOS 的 fsnotify/kqueue 工作区后端，每个工作区监视根使用一个原生流，而不是随目录树增长的描述符。

title.en: Project tree reorder during topic switches fixed
title.zh: 修复切换会话时项目树临时乱序

body.en: Kept single-surface topic switching on the runtime projection path and indexed committed transcript/sidecar changes by exact session path.
body.zh: 在运行时投影路径上保持单表面主题切换，并按精确会话路径索引已提交的转录/边车更改。

title.en: Unfinished todo readiness scoped to closed loops
title.zh: 未完成 todo 只在闭环回合阻塞

body.en: Ordinary open turns now finish normally when a partially completed todo list is cross-turn work state, while preserving enforcement for Goal, approved Plan, and strict-obligation turns.
body.zh: 当部分完成的 todo 列表是跨回合工作状态时，普通开放回合现在正常结束，同时保留对 Goal、已批准 Plan 和严格义务回合的执行。

title.en: Ordered batch sign-offs with anchor safety
title.zh: 按序批量签收与锚点安全门禁

body.en: Multiple evidence-backed complete_step calls in one provider tool-call round with canonical Todo ordering, sequential host advancement, rejection semantics, and idempotency. Host-only model-visible text observations and closed-interval SHA-256 fingerprints for delete_range.
body.zh: 在一个提供方工具调用回合中进行多个有证据支持的 complete_step 调用，具有规范的 Todo 顺序、顺序主机推进、拒绝语义和幂等性。为 delete_range 添加仅主机可见的模型文本观察和闭区间 SHA-256 指纹。

title.zh: 会话导航与滚动所有权

body.en: Fixed stale transcript navigation, preserved upward reader intent, converged transcript tail on native geometry, and fixed question navigation clicks. Cross-session navigation hides source content synchronously.
body.zh: 修复了过期的会话导航，保留了向上阅读意图，使会话尾部收敛于原生几何，并修复了问题导航点击。跨会话导航同步隐藏源内容。

title.zh: 桌面窗口生命周期恢复

body.en: Coordinated main-window presentation through one App-owned lifecycle path, gated Linux close-to-background on live StatusNotifier registration, and treated Wayland activation as compositor acknowledgement.
body.zh: 通过一个 App 拥有的生命周期路径协调主窗口呈现，在实时 StatusNotifier 注册上限制 Linux 关闭到后台，并将 Wayland 激活视为合成器确认。

title.en: Provider Responses tool turns without reasoning
title.zh: Responses 缺少推理的工具回合

body.en: Recovered DeepSeek and MiMo Responses tool turns when the provider omits an optional reasoning item, with effort-aware replay requirements.
body.zh: 当提供方省略可选推理项时，恢复了 DeepSeek 和 MiMo Responses 工具回合，并具有努力感知的重放要求。

title.zh: 工具结果缓存前缀稳定性

body.en: Kept each provider-visible tool result on the stable persisted Content representation, bounded to 32 KiB, while retaining the complete local value in RawContent.
body.zh: 将每个提供方可见的工具结果保持在稳定的持久化 Content 表示上，限制为 32 KiB，同时在 RawContent 中保留完整的本地值。

title.zh: macOS 工作区监听使用 FSEvents

body.en: Replaced the macOS fsnotify/kqueue workspace backend with Apple FSEvents, using one native stream per workspace watch root instead of descriptors that grow with the directory tree.
body.zh: 用 Apple FSEvents 替换了 macOS 的 fsnotify/kqueue 工作区后端，每个工作区监视根使用一个原生流，而不是随目录树增长的描述符。

title.en: Project tree reorder during topic switches
title.zh: 切换会话时项目树临时乱序

body.en: Kept single-surface topic switching on the runtime projection path and indexed committed transcript/sidecar changes by exact session path.
body.zh: 在运行时投影路径上保持单表面主题切换，并按精确会话路径索引已提交的转录/边车更改。

title.en: Unfinished todo readiness scoped to closed loops
title.zh: 未完成 todo 只在闭环回合阻塞

body.en: Ordinary open turns now finish normally when a partially completed todo list is cross-turn work state, while preserving enforcement for Goal, approved Plan, and strict-obligation turns.
body.zh: 当部分完成的 todo 列表是跨回合工作状态时，普通开放回合现在正常结束，同时保留对 Goal、已批准 Plan 和严格义务回合的执行。

title.en: DeepSeek V4 scheduled pricing and Pro low reasoning effort
title.zh: DeepSeek V4 峰谷价格与 Pro low 推理强度

summary.en: Introduces effective-dated peak and off-peak pricing for DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro, a unified cost quote across all surfaces, and support for low reasoning effort on DeepSeek V4 Pro.
summary.zh: 引入 DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Pro 的峰谷价格，统一各端成本报价，并支持 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 low 推理强度。

body.en: Learn how DeepSeek V4 peak and off-peak pricing is applied and how to configure custom endpoints.
body.zh: 了解 DeepSeek V4 峰谷价格如何应用以及如何配置自定义端点。

body.en: Chinese documentation for DeepSeek V4 billing and pricing.
body.zh: DeepSeek V4 计费与价格的中文文档。

body.en: Details on supported reasoning providers and reasoning effort levels.
body.zh: 支持的推理提供商和推理强度级别的详细信息。

body.en: Chinese documentation for reasoning providers and effort levels.
body.zh: 推理提供商和推理强度级别的中文文档。

title.en: Bounded tool results preserve prompt-cache prefixes
title.zh: 有界工具结果保持提示词缓存前缀

body.en: Large tool results now keep a stable provider-visible 32KB representation while retaining the complete local result for explicit paged recovery. This fixes avoidable context growth and prefix churn; provider-side cache hit rates still depend on model and cache state.
body.zh: 大工具结果现在使用稳定的 provider 可见 32KB 表示，同时在本地保留完整结果供显式分页恢复。该修复避免不必要的上下文增长和前缀变化；供应商侧缓存命中率仍取决于模型与缓存状态。

title.en: DeepSeek V4 peak and off-peak pricing

body.en: Effective-dated peak and off-peak pricing for DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro is now applied automatically for official endpoints with default pricing. Peak windows are 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC.
body.zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Pro 的峰谷价格现已自动应用于使用默认价格的官方端点。峰时窗口为 UTC 01:00–04:00 和 06:00–10:00。

title.en: Low reasoning effort for DeepSeek V4 Pro
title.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 的 low 推理强度

body.en: You can now select low reasoning effort for DeepSeek V4 Pro across OpenAI Chat, Responses, and Anthropic protocols.
body.zh: 现在可以在 OpenAI Chat、Responses 和 Anthropic 协议中为 DeepSeek V4 Pro 选择 low 推理强度。

title.en: Unified cost quotes across all surfaces

body.en: A single occurrence-time cost quote is now reused across budget enforcement, events, stats, CLI, ACP, and desktop surfaces, ensuring consistent pricing display.
body.zh: 现在在预算执行、事件、统计、CLI、ACP 和桌面端统一使用单次发生时的成本报价，确保价格显示一致。

title.zh: 峰时、谷时和混合费率标签

body.en: CLI and desktop UI now show peak, off-peak, and mixed-rate labels, with an accessible mixed-rate badge in the context panel.
body.zh: CLI 和桌面 UI 现在显示峰时、谷时和混合费率标签，并在上下文面板中提供可访问的混合费率徽章。

body.en: Added effective-dated peak and off-peak pricing catalogs for DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro in CNY and USD.
body.zh: 为 DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 Pro 添加了人民币和美元的有效期峰谷价格目录。

title.zh: 支持 low 推理强度

body.en: Added support for low reasoning effort on DeepSeek V4 Pro across OpenAI Chat, Responses, and Anthropic protocols.
body.zh: 在 OpenAI Chat、Responses 和 Anthropic 协议中为 DeepSeek V4 Pro 添加了 low 推理强度支持。

body.en: Calculates one occurrence-time cost quote and reuses it across budget enforcement, events, stats, CLI, ACP, and desktop surfaces.
body.zh: 计算单次发生时的成本报价，并在预算执行、事件、统计、CLI、ACP 和桌面端复用。

body.en: Shows peak, off-peak, and mixed-rate labels in CLI and desktop UI, with an accessible mixed-rate badge in the context panel.
body.zh: 在 CLI 和桌面 UI 中显示峰时、谷时和混合费率标签，并在上下文面板中提供可访问的混合费率徽章。
