body.en: Migrates exact official default pricing to config v7 without overwriting custom endpoints, custom prices, or historical charges.
body.zh: 将精确的官方默认价格迁移到配置 v7，不会覆盖自定义端点、自定义价格或历史费用。

title.zh: 稳定的大工具结果投影

body.en: Stops full local RawContent from being automatically promoted into sampling, retries, summaries, and projection replay. Complete text remains losslessly available through the session-scoped paged capability.
body.zh: 不再将本地完整 RawContent 自动提升到采样、重试、摘要和投影回放中；完整原文仍可通过会话隔离的分页能力无损读取。

summary.en: This release focuses on desktop reliability and usability improvements, including fixes for long-session scrolling, terminal clipboard integration, project tree organization, and provider recovery.
summary.zh: 此版本专注于桌面应用的可靠性和易用性改进，包括修复长会话滚动、终端剪贴板集成、项目树组织以及供应商恢复。

body.en: Learn how to use Reasonix effectively.
body.zh: 了解如何有效使用 Reasonix。

body.en: Chinese version of the user guide.
body.zh: 用户指南的中文版本。

title.en: Long sessions can now scroll to the bottom
title.zh: 长会话现在可以滚动到底部

body.en: Rebuilt the session scrolling system around a single-writer arbiter, fixing the issue where very long sessions could not reach the latest content.
body.zh: 围绕单一写入者仲裁器重建了会话滚动系统，修复了超长会话无法到达最新内容的问题。

title.zh: 集成终端剪贴板和选中内容添加到聊天

body.en: The integrated terminal now supports copy/paste and adding selections to chat, with proper lifecycle management.
body.zh: 集成终端现在支持复制/粘贴以及将选中内容添加到聊天，并具有适当的生命周期管理。

title.en: Project tree organization: manual ordering and session groups
title.zh: 项目树组织：手动排序和会话分组

body.en: Topics can now be manually reordered via drag-and-drop, and collapsible session groups can be created within projects.
body.zh: 现在可以通过拖拽手动重新排序主题，并在项目内创建可折叠的会话分组。

body.en: Sessions with malformed reasoning history now recover automatically without user intervention.
body.zh: 具有格式错误的推理历史的会话现在可以自动恢复，无需用户干预。

title.en: Manual drag-to-reorder topics in project tree
title.zh: 项目树中手动拖拽排序主题

body.en: Topic rows in the project tree (project + global workspace) can now be manually reordered via drag-and-drop. Order persists through the new ReorderTopics IPC into the existing ordered Topics/GlobalTopics arrays in projects.json.
body.zh: 项目树中的主题行（项目 + 全局工作区）现在可以通过拖放手动重新排序。顺序通过新的 ReorderTopics IPC 持久化到 projects.json 中现有的有序 Topics/GlobalTopics 数组。

title.en: In-project session groups for folding topics
title.zh: 项目内会话分组用于折叠主题

body.en: Phase 2 of #8194 — in-project session groups as foldable UI containers (project → group → topic). Groups persist in projects.json (desktopProject.Groups / GlobalGroups), managed via new ListProjectGroups / SaveSessionGroups IPC.
body.zh: #8194 的第二阶段——项目内会话分组作为可折叠的 UI 容器（项目 → 组 → 主题）。组持久化在 projects.json 中（desktopProject.Groups / GlobalGroups），通过新的 ListProjectGroups / SaveSessionGroups IPC 管理。

title.en: Aggregate active-session indicator on collapsed project folders
title.zh: 折叠项目文件夹上的聚合活跃会话指示器

body.en: Collapsed project/global folder rows now show a small spinner when any child session is in-flight (thinking/streaming/waiting_confirmation/background_job).
body.zh: 当任何子会话正在进行（思考/流式传输/等待确认/后台作业）时，折叠的项目/全局文件夹行现在会显示一个小旋转指示器。

title.en: Align context compaction with DeepSeek Harness
title.zh: 与 DeepSeek Harness 对齐上下文压缩

body.en: Automatic context compaction now aligns with DeepSeek Harness semantics: 80% default threshold, fixed 16% recent tail, and at most two successful pressure summaries.
body.zh: 自动上下文压缩现在与 DeepSeek Harness 语义对齐：80% 默认阈值、固定 16% 最近尾部，以及最多两次成功的压力摘要。

title.en: Preserve AI session titles on reasoning models
title.zh: 在推理模型上保留 AI 会话标题

body.en: The desktop AI rename session action can now return a visible title on reasoning models instead of failing after a reasoning-only completion.
body.zh: 桌面 AI 重命名会话操作现在可以在推理模型上返回可见标题，而不是在仅推理完成后失败。

title.en: Default Kotlin LSP to official kotlin-lsp
title.zh: Kotlin 默认 LSP 切换为官方 kotlin-lsp

body.en: The Kotlin default language server now points to the official JetBrains kotlin-lsp instead of the deprecated fwcd/kotlin-language-server.
body.zh: Kotlin 默认语言服务器现在指向 JetBrains 官方 kotlin-lsp，而不是已弃用的 fwcd/kotlin-language-server。

title.en: Canonicalize official Token Rhythm API paths
title.zh: 自动修复基元律动官方 API 路径

body.en: Automatically repair known official Token Rhythm API path mistakes before the first request, such as missing /v1 or duplicated /v1.
body.zh: 在首次请求前自动修复已知的基元律动官方 API 路径错误，例如缺少 /v1 或重复 /v1。

title.zh: 桌面运行时重载进程替换

body.en: Desktop now supports /reload from the composer and restarts unchanged native v2 plugin sidecars during an explicit full reload.
body.zh: 桌面端现在支持从输入框使用 /reload，并在显式重载时为未改变清单的原生插件启动新进程。

title.en: Stop old sessions flipping back to unread
title.zh: 修复旧会话反复变成未读

body.en: Old sidebar sessions no longer show unread dots after being clicked; unread state is now keyed on logical topic and a one-time baseline prevents false unread.
body.zh: 旧侧边栏会话在点击后不再显示未读点；未读状态现在基于逻辑主题，并且一次性基线防止错误的未读。

title.en: Don't raise last_activity_at from file mtime
title.zh: 不再从文件 mtime 提升 last_activity_at

body.en: After upgrades or external file touches, historical sessions no longer show as 'just now'; file mtime is only a fallback when authoritative timestamps are missing.
body.zh: 升级或外部文件触碰后，历史会话不再显示为“刚刚”；文件 mtime 仅在权威时间戳缺失时作为后备。

title.zh: 修复消息队列已执行内容残留

body.en: Guidance that already entered the transcript no longer remains visible in the Composer queue, and stopping a turn no longer restores already-admitted messages.
body.zh: 已进入转录的指导不再保留在 Composer 队列中，停止回合不再恢复已接纳的消息。

title.zh: 自动补齐普通任务的收尾验证

body.en: Ordinary interactive turns now automatically continue when the host can name a safe remaining verification or review obligation.
body.zh: 当主机能够指出安全剩余的验证或审查义务时，普通交互回合现在会自动继续。

title.en: Fix composer timer across tab switches
title.zh: 修复切换会话后运行计时归零

body.en: The composer timer now continues instead of restarting at zero when switching tabs, and stale snapshots cannot rewind or stop a turn.
body.zh: 切换标签页时，Composer 计时器现在继续而不是从零重新开始，并且过时的快照无法倒回或停止回合。

title.en: Keep the viewport steady when auto-fold collapse shrinks the transcript
title.zh: 思考区自动折叠收缩时不再追底跳动

body.en: Auto-fold collapse of the reasoning panel no longer drags the transcript viewport with an imperative tail re-aim.
body.zh: 推理面板的自动折叠收缩不再通过命令式尾部重新瞄准拖动转录视口。

title.en: Reasonix v1.25.3: Adaptive execution, smoother streaming, and more robust recovery
title.zh: Reasonix v1.25.3：自适应执行、更流畅的流式体验与更稳健的恢复

summary.en: This release replaces execution modes with a unified adaptive standard policy, makes desktop streaming and scrolling more reliable, and strengthens context recovery, session ownership, and provider compatibility.
summary.zh: 本次发布用统一的自适应标准策略取代执行模式，让桌面端流式输出与滚动更可靠，并强化了上下文恢复、会话所有权与提供商兼容性。

body.en: Reasonix now derives a per-turn policy from intent, risk, structure, and constraints, replacing Light, Balanced, and Delivery modes.
body.zh: Reasonix 现在根据意图、风险、结构与约束逐轮推导策略，取代轻量、均衡与交付模式。

body.en: Session writers are isolated, rewind is fork-first, and recovery branches remain stable across restarts.
body.zh: 会话写者被隔离，回溯采用分叉优先，恢复分支在重启后保持稳定。

body.en: On-demand write-access grants let file tools and Bash request permission for directories outside the workspace.
body.zh: 按需写入授权让文件工具与 Bash 可请求工作区外目录的写入权限。

title.en: Unified adaptive execution replaces Light, Balanced, and Delivery modes
title.zh: 统一自适应执行策略取代轻量、均衡与交付模式

body.en: Reasonix no longer requires choosing an execution mode. Each turn derives a policy from intent, risk, structure, and constraints, used for planning, verification, and evidence closure.
body.zh: Reasonix 不再要求选择执行模式。每轮根据意图、风险、结构与约束推导策略，并用于规划、验证与证据闭环。

title.en: Desktop streaming and scrolling are now stable
title.zh: 桌面端流式输出与滚动现已稳定

body.en: The active turn renders outside the virtual list, eliminating flicker, snap-backs, and tail loss on Windows and WebView2. The todo panel updates in real time.
body.zh: 活跃轮次在虚拟列表外渲染，消除了 Windows 与 WebView2 上的闪烁、回跳与尾部丢失。待办面板实时更新。

title.zh: 上下文溢出恢复持续推进

body.en: Repeated hard context overflows in long tool turns can now recover after token-saving checkpoints instead of aborting with an error.
body.zh: 长工具轮次中反复出现的硬上下文溢出现在可在节省令牌的检查点后恢复，而不是报错中止。

title.zh: 修复 DeepSeek Anthropic 推理回放

body.en: Tool-bound assistant turns now replay required thinking blocks, avoiding HTTP 400 errors on subsequent requests.
body.zh: 工具绑定的助手轮次现在会回放所需的思考块，避免后续请求出现 HTTP 400 错误。

title.en: On-demand write authorization for sandbox tools
title.zh: 沙箱工具按需写入授权

body.en: File tools and Bash can request write permission for directories outside the workspace, with once, session, project, or deny decisions.
body.zh: 文件工具与 Bash 可请求工作区外目录的写入权限，支持一次、会话、项目或拒绝等决策。

body.en: Replaces Light, Balanced, and Delivery modes with a single policy derived per turn from intent, risk, and structure.
body.zh: 用根据意图、风险与结构逐轮推导的单一策略取代轻量、均衡与交付模式。

body.en: File tools and Bash can request write permission for directories outside the workspace, with once, session, project, or deny decisions.
body.zh: 文件工具与 Bash 可请求工作区外目录的写入权限，支持一次、会话、项目或拒绝等决策。

title.zh: 持续展开推理显示模式

body.en: New explicit expanded mode keeps completed reasoning open and applies consistently to assistant messages, inline transcript reasoning, and sub-agent previews.
body.zh: 新增显式的展开模式，使已完成的推理保持展开，并一致应用于助手消息、内联转录推理和子代理预览。

body.en: Built-in presets for the National Supercomputing Internet (SCNet) Token Plan, including OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
body.zh: 新增国家超算互联网（SCNet）Token Plan 的内置预设，包括 OpenAI 兼容和 Anthropic 兼容端点。

title.en: Unified AI and agent session naming
title.zh: 统一 AI 与 Agent 会话命名

body.en: New cache-stable set_session_title capability and desktop AI rename action, with consistent title updates across catalog, history, and project tree.
body.zh: 新增缓存稳定的 set_session_title 能力和桌面端 AI 重命名操作，并在目录、历史记录和项目树中一致更新标题。

title.zh: 桌面端流式输出与滚动稳定性

body.en: Active turn renders outside the virtual list, eliminating flicker, snap-backs, and tail loss; todo panel updates in real time.
body.zh: 活跃轮次在虚拟列表外渲染，消除闪烁、回跳与尾部丢失；待办面板实时更新。

body.en: Repeated hard context overflows can recover after token-saving checkpoints instead of aborting.
body.zh: 反复出现的硬上下文溢出可在节省令牌的检查点后恢复，而不是中止。

body.en: Writers are isolated, rewind is fork-first, and recovery branches remain stable across restarts.
body.zh: 写者被隔离，回溯采用分叉优先，恢复分支在重启后保持稳定。

body.en: Ordinary requests enter the executor directly, while planning is reserved for explicit plans, approval boundaries, and goal starts; verification obligations come from concrete tool calls.
body.zh: 普通请求直接进入执行器，规划仅用于显式计划、审批边界和目标启动；验证义务由具体工具调用生成。

body.en: Readiness gaps and controlled pauses return compliant end_turn outcomes; genuine failures return JSON-RPC InternalError with redacted causes.
body.zh: 就绪差距与受控暂停返回合规的 end_turn 结果；真实故障返回带脱敏原因的 JSON-RPC InternalError。

body.en: Replaced per-directory watches with one recursive subscription per workspace root, avoiding nested directory locks.
body.zh: 用每个工作区根目录的单个递归订阅取代逐目录监视，避免嵌套目录锁定。

title.zh: 侧边栏新会话标题本地化

body.en: Auto-generated default titles now localize to the desktop language in the sidebar catalog.
body.zh: 自动生成的默认标题现在会在侧边栏目录中按桌面语言本地化。

body.en: Missing verification evidence no longer interrupts ordinary mutations; gaps are surfaced in the completion summary.
body.zh: 缺少验证证据不再中断普通变更；差距会在完成摘要中显示。

title.en: SSH remote window frame on Windows
title.zh: Windows 上 SSH 远程窗口框架

body.en: Remote windows now keep the native OS frame, providing titlebar and window controls.
body.zh: 远程窗口现在保留原生操作系统框架，提供标题栏和窗口控件。

body.en: Tool-bound assistant turns replay required thinking blocks, avoiding HTTP 400 errors.
body.zh: 工具绑定的助手轮次回放所需的思考块，避免 HTTP 400 错误。

body.en: Valid compaction projections are restored after restart instead of falling back to the full transcript.
body.zh: 重启后恢复有效的压缩投影，而不是回退到完整转录。

title.zh: 清除 Windows 与策略阻断

body.en: Fixed invalid TOML fixture on Windows and clause-aware mutation constraints that blocked scoped protections.
body.zh: 修复 Windows 上无效的 TOML 夹具和阻止作用域保护的子句感知变更约束。

body.en: Pinned Mermaid transitive DOMPurify to patched 3.4.13, clearing a moderate runtime XSS advisory.
body.zh: 将 Mermaid 传递依赖的 DOMPurify 固定到已修复的 3.4.13，清除中等运行时 XSS 公告。

title.en: Desktop stability and agent reliability improvements
title.zh: 桌面端稳定性与智能体可靠性改进

summary.en: This release focuses on desktop stability, session management, and agent behavior fixes, including persistent reasoning display, memory approval alignment, adaptive planner research, and numerous UI and performance improvements.
summary.zh: 此版本专注于桌面端稳定性、会话管理和智能体行为修复，包括持续展开的推理显示、记忆审批对齐、自适应规划器调研，以及大量 UI 和性能改进。

body.en: Learn how Auto and YOLO modes handle memory tool approvals.
body.zh: 了解 Auto 和 YOLO 模式如何处理记忆工具审批。

body.en: Chinese guide for tool approval modes.
body.zh: 工具审批模式中文指南。

title.zh: 持续展开的推理显示模式

body.en: Added an explicit expanded reasoning display mode that keeps completed reasoning open across assistant messages, inline transcripts, and sub-agent previews.
body.zh: 新增显式的展开推理显示模式，使已完成的推理在助手消息、内联转录和子代理预览中保持展开。

title.en: Memory approvals now respect Auto and YOLO modes
title.zh: 记忆审批现在遵循 Auto 和 YOLO 模式

body.en: Memory tools no longer force approval prompts in Auto and YOLO modes; explicit ask and deny rules still apply.
body.zh: 记忆工具在 Auto 和 YOLO 模式下不再强制弹出审批提示；显式的 ask 和 deny 规则仍然有效。

body.en: Planner no longer has fixed research round limits; it continues until a valid plan is submitted or safety boundaries are hit.
body.zh: 规划器不再有固定的调研轮数限制；它会持续进行，直到提交有效计划或触发安全边界。

title.en: Desktop session and UI stability fixes
title.zh: 桌面端会话与 UI 稳定性修复

body.en: Fixed multiple issues including session switching prompts, pinned chats after restart, project tree loops, and transcript scrolling.
body.zh: 修复了多个问题，包括会话切换提示、重启后置顶会话、项目树循环和转录滚动。

title.zh: 持续展开的推理显示模式

body.en: Added an explicit expanded reasoning display mode that keeps completed reasoning open.
body.zh: 新增显式的展开推理显示模式，使已完成的推理保持展开。

body.en: ACP session status now exposes totalTokens as the authoritative inclusive total.
body.zh: ACP 会话状态现在暴露 totalTokens 作为权威的包含总数。

body.en: Removed fixed research round limits; planner continues until a valid plan is submitted.
body.zh: 移除了固定的调研轮数限制；规划器会持续进行，直到提交有效计划。

title.en: MCP tool refresh after list changes
title.zh: MCP 工具列表变更后自动刷新

body.en: Refresh connected MCP tool catalogs after notifications/tools/list_changed.
body.zh: 在 notifications/tools/list_changed 后刷新已连接的 MCP 工具目录。

title.zh: 桌面端性能与稳定性改进

body.en: Various improvements to rendering, workspace, catalog, and WebView2 stability.
body.zh: 对渲染、工作区、目录和 WebView2 稳定性的各种改进。

title.en: Memory approvals respect Auto and YOLO modes
title.zh: 记忆审批遵循 Auto 和 YOLO 模式

body.en: Memory tools no longer force approval prompts in Auto and YOLO modes.
body.zh: 记忆工具在 Auto 和 YOLO 模式下不再强制弹出审批提示。

title.en: complete_step terminal message on final todo
title.zh: 最后一个待办完成时返回终止消息

body.en: complete_step now returns a terminal message when the final todo is completed, preventing infinite loops.
body.zh: complete_step 现在在最后一个待办完成时返回终止消息，防止无限循环。

title.zh: 桌面端会话与 UI 修复

body.en: Fixed session switching prompts, pinned chats after restart, project tree loops, transcript scrolling, and more.
body.zh: 修复了会话切换提示、重启后置顶会话、项目树循环、转录滚动等问题。

title.en: Desktop stability and provider compatibility fixes
title.zh: 桌面端稳定性与提供商兼容性修复

summary.en: This patch release fixes multiple desktop transcript, sidebar, and session recovery issues, improves provider compatibility with DeepSeek and Anthropic gateways, and refines Goal mode verification behavior.
summary.zh: 此补丁版本修复了多个桌面端对话记录、侧边栏和会话恢复问题，改进了与 DeepSeek 和 Anthropic 网关的提供商兼容性，并优化了 Goal 模式的验证行为。

body.en: Updated to describe the completion path for unverified checks and stopping repeated completions.
body.zh: 已更新，描述未验证检查的完成路径和重复完成停止。

body.en: Updated to describe the completion path for unverified checks and stopping repeated completions.
body.zh: 已更新，描述未验证检查的完成路径和重复完成停止。

body.en: Updated to describe the completion path for unverified checks and stopping repeated completions.
body.zh: 已更新，描述未验证检查的完成路径和重复完成停止。

body.en: Updated to describe official DeepSeek 384K output ceiling behavior.
body.zh: 已更新，描述官方 DeepSeek 384K 输出上限行为。

body.en: Updated to describe official DeepSeek 384K output ceiling behavior.
body.zh: 已更新，描述官方 DeepSeek 384K 输出上限行为。

body.en: Updated to describe the completion path for unverified checks and stopping repeated completions.
body.zh: 已更新，描述未验证检查的完成路径和重复完成停止。

title.en: Restored sidebar and transcript behavior after upgrades
title.zh: 恢复升级后的侧边栏和对话记录行为

body.en: Fixed issues where the sidebar could be empty after an upgrade, old sessions repeatedly showed unread dots, and opening a recovered conversation showed only the older half. The latest covering leaf is now opened correctly.
body.zh: 修复了升级后侧边栏可能为空、旧会话反复显示未读点、打开恢复的对话只显示前半段的问题。现在会正确打开最新的覆盖叶子。

title.zh: 改进流式输出中的历史记录加载

body.en: Opening a session that is already running or streaming now loads the history page before the live turn, making previous turns and tool cards immediately visible.
body.zh: 打开正在运行或流式输出的会话时，现在会在实时回合前加载历史页面，使之前的回合和工具卡片立即可见。

title.en: Provider compatibility with DeepSeek and Anthropic gateways
title.zh: 与 DeepSeek 和 Anthropic 网关的提供商兼容性

body.en: Official DeepSeek now follows the documented 384K output ceiling instead of a custom auto ladder; Anthropic-compatible gateways that omit message_stop but provide stop_reason are no longer treated as interrupted.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek 现在遵循文档化的 384K 输出上限，而不是自定义自动阶梯；省略 message_stop 但提供 stop_reason 的 Anthropic 兼容网关不再被视为中断。

title.zh: Goal 模式验证循环预防

body.en: Goal mode no longer loops on the same verification after an honest update_goal(complete). Unverified checks are honored on Light/Balanced, and a second identical complete is accepted when only check gaps remain.
body.zh: Goal 模式在诚实申报 update_goal(complete) 后不再陷入相同的验证循环。Light/Balanced 上会尊重未验证的检查，并且当仅剩检查缺口时接受第二次相同的完成申报。

title.en: Web search results as a separate card with footnotes
title.zh: 搜索结果独立卡片并保留脚注

body.en: Provider-executed web_search now appears as a foldable process card instead of being dumped into the assistant answer. The confirmed title and link list is restored as footnotes under the answer.
body.zh: 提供商执行的 web_search 现在显示为可折叠的过程卡片，而不是直接写入助手回答。确认的标题和链接列表恢复为回答下方的脚注。

title.zh: 会话收件箱隔离与恢复

body.en: Restored desktop session-inbox recovery so queued guidance stays on the session that created it, can be reviewed/edited/deleted, and can take effect mid-turn. Composer inbox snapshots are isolated by session path.
body.zh: 恢复了桌面会话收件箱，使排队的指导保留在创建它的会话上，可以查看/编辑/删除，并可在回合中途生效。Composer 收件箱快照按会话路径隔离。

title.en: Encrypted web_search replay excluded from compact estimates
title.zh: 密文搜索回放不计入 compact 估算

body.en: Compact, overflow, and interrupted-usage estimates no longer count encrypted web_search replay payloads as ordinary prompt text, preventing unnecessary early compaction.
body.zh: Compact、溢出和中断使用估算不再将加密的 web_search 回放负载计为普通提示文本，避免不必要的提前压缩。

title.en: History transcript scrolls to native bottom
title.zh: 历史会话滚动到原生底部

body.en: History desktop sessions can now reach their last rows with the mouse wheel and jump-to-bottom control, not only by dragging the native scrollbar.
body.zh: 历史桌面会话现在可以通过鼠标滚轮和跳到底部控件到达最后几行，而不仅仅是通过拖动原生滚动条。

title.en: Archive fallback blanks hidden from sidebar
title.zh: 归档后不再在侧栏显示空白会话

body.en: Clicking Archive removes the conversation and does not add visible blank rows. Leftover empty or unindexed default-title session files are discarded after archive.
body.zh: 点击归档会移除对话，并且不会添加可见的空白行。归档后丢弃残留的空或未索引的默认标题会话文件。

title.en: Completed todo dismissals persisted on session
title.zh: 关闭待办写入会话文件

body.en: Closing a completed desktop todo shelf now follows the session file, so it stays hidden after an upgrade remounts the conversation or the WebView2 profile is reset.
body.zh: 关闭已完成的桌面待办事项现在会跟随会话文件，因此在升级重新挂载对话或重置 WebView2 配置文件后仍保持隐藏。

title.en: Transcript stays pinned after todo dismiss
title.zh: 关闭待办后会话画面保持固定

body.en: Dismissing a completed todo shelf no longer jumps the visible chat back to an earlier todo list. Retry and failed-clear hydrates stop replacing a longer live transcript with a shorter snapshot.
body.zh: 关闭已完成的待办事项不再使可见聊天跳回之前的待办列表。重试和清除失败的水合不再用较短的快照替换较长的实时记录。

title.en: Live topic runtime attached instead of old catalog leaf
title.zh: 点活会话时附着当前 runtime，不再打开旧副本

body.en: Clicking a sidebar topic that is already running or paused now attaches that live runtime instead of opening the catalog representative.
body.zh: 点击已在运行或暂停的侧边栏主题现在会附着该实时运行时，而不是打开目录代表。

title.zh: 交付检查暂停单独标记

body.en: Sidebar sessions that stop on a Goal/delivery-check gate now show '待交付检查' / 'need checks' instead of reusing the recovery-pause badge.
body.zh: 在 Goal/交付检查门处停止的侧边栏会话现在显示“待交付检查”/“need checks”，而不是复用恢复暂停徽章。

title.en: Mid-stream history restored and Auto Guard steers hidden
title.zh: 恢复中途历史并隐藏 Auto Guard 引导

body.en: Opening a session whose turn was already running or streaming now prepends a history page. Host Auto Guard guidance is hidden from the user-side transcript and kept on the failed tool result for the model.
body.zh: 打开回合已在运行或流式输出的会话现在会在前面添加历史页面。主机 Auto Guard 指导从用户侧记录中隐藏，并保留在失败的工具结果中供模型使用。

title.en: Old sessions no longer flip back to unread
title.zh: 旧会话不再反复变成未读

body.en: Unread state is now keyed on the logical topic, a one-time read baseline is seeded, and catalog/sidecar maintenance no longer mints fake 'now' activity.
body.zh: 未读状态现在基于逻辑主题，设置一次性已读基线，目录/边车维护不再伪造“现在”活动。

summary.en: Fixes for streaming markdown rendering, transcript layout and session switching, plus improvements to command safety classification and agent progress tracking.
summary.zh: 修复流式 Markdown 渲染、对话布局和会话切换问题，并改进命令安全分类和智能体进度跟踪。

title.en: Streaming lists render completed items immediately
title.zh: 流式列表立即渲染已完成项

body.en: Tight markdown lists no longer flash raw source while answers stream; completed items now render as they arrive.
body.zh: 紧凑的 Markdown 列表在答案流式传输时不再闪现原始源码；已完成项现在会随到达即时渲染。

title.en: Transcript layout fixes for scrolling and workspace dock
title.zh: 修复滚动和工作区停靠栏的对话布局

body.en: Fixed overlapping text when scrolling up, cropped user bubbles when the workspace dock is open, and ghost bubbles in short chats.
body.zh: 修复了向上滚动时文本重叠、打开工作区停靠栏时用户气泡被裁切以及短对话中的幽灵气泡问题。

title.en: Thinking transcript restored after session switch
title.zh: 会话切换后恢复思考中的对话记录

body.en: Switching back to a conversation that is still thinking now shows the live transcript instead of the welcome screen.
body.zh: 切换回仍在思考的对话时，现在会显示实时对话记录，而不是欢迎屏幕。

title.zh: 更智能的命令安全分类

body.en: Command effects are now classified with argument-aware rules, reducing false positives for read-only commands and correctly blocking mutating ones.
body.zh: 命令效果现在使用参数感知规则进行分类，减少只读命令的误报，并正确阻止有变更的命令。

title.en: Agent progress tracking based on actual progress
title.zh: 基于实际进度的智能体进度跟踪

body.en: The no-progress guard now prices a turn's progress instead of counting rounds, allowing honest investigation to continue longer.
body.zh: 无进展防护现在根据回合的实际进展来评估，而不是计算轮数，让诚实的调查可以持续更长时间。

title.en: DeepSeek Responses preset now includes Pro model
title.zh: DeepSeek Responses 预设现在包含 Pro 模型

body.en: The official DeepSeek Responses preset now supports deepseek-v4-pro alongside deepseek-v4-flash, with automatic upgrade for existing configs.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek Responses 预设现在支持 deepseek-v4-pro 和 deepseek-v4-flash，并自动升级现有配置。

title.en: DeepSeek Responses preset extended to Pro
title.zh: DeepSeek Responses 预设扩展支持 Pro

body.en: The official DeepSeek Responses preset now includes deepseek-v4-pro with per-model pricing and reasoning-effort overrides.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek Responses 预设现在包含 deepseek-v4-pro，并带有按模型定价和推理力度覆盖。

body.en: Replaced coarse read-only boolean with argument-aware CommandEffect model, fixing misclassification of commands like git branch -a and git commit.
body.zh: 用参数感知的 CommandEffect 模型替换了粗略的只读布尔值，修复了 git branch -a 和 git commit 等命令的误分类。

title.en: Agent progress guard now prices progress
title.zh: 智能体进度防护现在评估进度

body.en: The no-progress guard uses a per-turn account that rewards new observations and landed changes, avoiding premature stops.
body.zh: 无进展防护使用按回合账户，奖励新观察和已落地的更改，避免过早停止。

title.en: Tool calls get explicit execution environment
title.zh: 工具调用获得显式执行环境

body.en: Introduced tool.ExecutionEnv to pass capabilities explicitly instead of through context, reducing silent degradation.
body.zh: 引入 tool.ExecutionEnv 以显式传递能力，而不是通过上下文，减少静默降级。

body.en: Completed list items now render during streaming instead of showing raw markdown source.
body.zh: 已完成的列表项现在在流式传输期间渲染，而不是显示原始 Markdown 源码。

body.en: Fixed overlapping text when scrolling up, cropped user bubbles with workspace dock open, and ghost bubbles in short chats.
body.zh: 修复了向上滚动时文本重叠、打开工作区停靠栏时用户气泡被裁切以及短对话中的幽灵气泡问题。

title.en: Thinking transcript restored after session switch
title.zh: 会话切换后恢复思考中的对话记录

body.en: Switching back to a thinking conversation now shows the live transcript instead of the welcome screen.
body.zh: 切换回思考中的对话时，现在会显示实时对话记录，而不是欢迎屏幕。

summary.en: Stability and recovery improvements for session persistence, transcript scrolling, and Windows startup.
summary.zh: 会话持久化、对话滚动和 Windows 启动的稳定性与恢复改进。

body.en: Learn how the session catalog organizes recovery copies and logical sessions.
body.zh: 了解会话目录如何组织恢复副本和逻辑会话。

body.en: Reference for configuration file locations and environment variables.
body.zh: 配置文件位置和环境变量参考。

title.en: Recovery lineages now appear as a single logical session
title.zh: 恢复谱系现在显示为单个逻辑会话

body.en: Recovery copies are folded into one ordinary list row, preventing duplicate-looking sessions after upgrades.
body.zh: 恢复副本折叠为单个普通列表行，防止升级后出现重复会话。

title.en: Sidebar no longer freezes on a wedged projection
title.zh: 侧边栏不再因投影卡死而冻结

body.en: Bounded sidebar reads and background metadata sync prevent permanent freezes when the session catalog pool is saturated.
body.zh: 限制侧边栏读取和后台元数据同步，防止会话目录连接池饱和时永久冻结。

title.en: Stable transcript scrolling during async row growth
title.zh: 异步行高变化时对话滚动稳定

body.en: React Virtuoso now owns virtual measurement, preventing jumps when Markdown or code blocks finish loading.
body.zh: React Virtuoso 现在负责虚拟测量，防止 Markdown 或代码块加载完成时跳动。

title.en: Windows startup no longer flashes console windows
title.zh: Windows 启动不再闪现控制台窗口

body.en: Startup git probes now use the hardened command wrapper, hiding console windows.
body.zh: 启动时的 git 探测现在使用加固的命令包装器，隐藏控制台窗口。

title.en: Lifecycle records are no longer lost to Windows sharing violations
title.zh: 生命周期记录不再因 Windows 共享冲突而丢失

body.en: Retry logic for rename and re-read operations ensures crash evidence is preserved when multiple instances start together.
body.zh: 重命名和重读操作的重试逻辑确保多个实例同时启动时保留崩溃证据。

title.en: Projection lineage rebinds across upgrades and model switches
title.zh: 投影 lineage 在升级和模型切换时重新绑定

body.en: Context projections are preserved when the lineage key changes, avoiding full-price compaction on resume.
body.zh: 当 lineage 键变化时保留上下文投影，避免恢复时全价压缩。

title.en: Recovery forks no longer multiply without bound
title.zh: 恢复分支不再无限增长

body.en: False diverged forks are prevented and depth-cap isolation is bounded to one file per writer.
body.zh: 防止误判 diverged 分支，并将深度上限隔离限制为每个写入者一个文件。

title.en: Session catalog now uses a disposable v4 database
title.zh: 会话目录现在使用一次性 v4 数据库

body.en: Logical projection and recovery roles are rebuilt from authoritative content, preventing cross-version write conflicts.
body.zh: 逻辑投影和恢复角色从权威内容重建，防止跨版本写入冲突。

title.en: Agent state refactored for clarity and safety
title.zh: Agent 状态重构以提高清晰度和安全性

body.en: Collaborators, configuration, and runtime lifetimes are separated, with guard tests preventing accidental state changes.
body.zh: 协作者、配置和运行时生命周期分离，并通过保护测试防止意外状态更改。

title.en: Compaction failure records preserved across folds
title.zh: 压缩失败记录在多次折叠中保留

body.en: Projection re-reads now keep tool execution details, so the model continues to see failure context.
body.zh: 投影重读现在保留工具执行细节，模型继续看到失败上下文。

body.en: Covered recovery copies are hidden from the project tree, reducing duplicate-looking sessions.
body.zh: 隐藏已覆盖的恢复副本，减少重复会话。

body.en: Generated bindings are excluded from measurement and stale budgets are resynced.
body.zh: 生成的绑定从测量中排除，过时的预算重新同步。

summary.en: Fixes recovery catalog and Windows startup regressions, and improves compaction to keep user constraints verbatim.
summary.zh: 修复恢复会话目录与 Windows 启动回归问题，并改进压缩以逐字保留用户约束。

body.en: Learn about configuration file locations and overrides.
body.zh: 了解配置文件位置和覆盖方式。

body.en: 了解配置文件位置和覆盖方式。
body.zh: 了解配置文件位置和覆盖方式。

body.en: Understand the session catalog and recovery copy management.
body.zh: 了解会话目录和恢复副本管理。

body.en: 了解会话目录和恢复副本管理。
body.zh: 了解会话目录和恢复副本管理。

body.en: Read the full specification for compaction and retention.
body.zh: 阅读压缩和保留的完整规范。

body.en: 阅读压缩和保留的完整规范。
body.zh: 阅读压缩和保留的完整规范。

title.en: Windows startup no longer flashes console windows
title.zh: Windows 启动不再闪现控制台窗口

body.en: Git probes during cold start now use the hardened command wrapper, preventing `git.exe` console windows from appearing.
body.zh: 冷启动期间的 Git 探测现在使用加固的命令包装器，防止出现 `git.exe` 控制台窗口。

title.en: Recovery copies are correctly classified in the session catalog
title.zh: 恢复副本在会话目录中正确分类

body.en: Recovery branches now carry the `RecoveryCopy` flag, preventing duplicate-looking sessions and enabling safe cleanup.
body.zh: 恢复分支现在带有 `RecoveryCopy` 标志，防止出现重复会话并支持安全清理。

title.zh: 压缩逐字保留用户约束

body.en: User turns in the fold region are now retained verbatim within a budget, ensuring constraints like API compatibility are not lost during summarization.
body.zh: 折叠区域中的用户轮次现在在预算内逐字保留，确保 API 兼容性等约束在摘要过程中不会丢失。

title.en: Compaction reports when retention budget is exceeded
title.zh: 压缩报告保留预算超出情况

body.en: Telemetry now includes `user_kept` and `user_dropped` counts, and a warning is emitted when a turn must be dropped, guiding use of `[[keep]]`.
body.zh: 遥测现在包含 `user_kept` 和 `user_dropped` 计数，并在必须丢弃轮次时发出警告，指导使用 `[[keep]]`。

title.en: Compaction retains user turns within a budget
title.zh: 压缩在预算内保留用户轮次

body.en: All user turns in the fold region are now kept verbatim up to a token budget, preventing loss of stated constraints.
body.zh: 折叠区域中的所有用户轮次现在在令牌预算内逐字保留，防止丢失声明的约束。

title.zh: 压缩遥测报告保留结果

body.en: Compaction now reports how many user turns were kept or dropped, and warns when a turn exceeds the budget.
body.zh: 压缩现在报告保留或丢弃的用户轮次数量，并在轮次超出预算时发出警告。

body.en: Git probes now use the hardened command wrapper, eliminating `git.exe` console windows on cold start.
body.zh: Git 探测现在使用加固的命令包装器，消除冷启动时的 `git.exe` 控制台窗口。

title.en: Recovery copy classification in session catalog
title.zh: 会话目录中的恢复副本分类

body.en: Recovery branches are now correctly marked as `RecoveryCopy`, preventing clutter and enabling safe cleanup.
body.zh: 恢复分支现在正确标记为 `RecoveryCopy`，防止混乱并支持安全清理。

title.en: Recovery copy double-counting and cleanup race
title.zh: 恢复副本重复计数和清理竞争

body.en: Adopted recovery turns are no longer double-counted, and cleanup now atomically guards against concurrent access.
body.zh: 采用的恢复轮次不再重复计数，清理现在原子性地防止并发访问。

title.en: Reasonix v1.24.0: Continuous Goals, Unified Execution, and Desktop Polish
title.zh: Reasonix v1.24.0：连续目标、统一执行与桌面体验优化

summary.en: Goals now run continuously until completion, with an optional token budget. Execution settings (light/balanced/delivery) replace work modes with a unified tool surface. Desktop gains crash diagnostics, streamlined task controls, and improved transcript scrolling. Billing is unified across all surfaces with multi-currency support.
summary.zh: 目标现在默认连续执行直至完成，并支持可选的 token 预算。执行设定（轻量/均衡/交付）取代工作模式，提供统一的工具面。桌面端新增崩溃诊断、精简的任务控制与改进的聊天区滚动。计费在全链路统一，支持多币种。

body.en: Updated for agent_preset and execution settings.
body.zh: 更新了 agent_preset 与执行设定相关内容。

body.en: Documents multi-currency billing architecture and migration.
body.zh: 记录了多币种计费架构与迁移。

body.en: Updated for /preset and execution settings.
body.zh: 更新了 /preset 与执行设定。

body.en: Updated for execution settings.
body.zh: 更新了执行设定。

body.en: Documents request_url and provider configuration.
body.zh: 记录了 request_url 与供应商配置。

body.en: Cross-platform crash diagnostics and runtime attribution.
body.zh: 跨平台崩溃诊断与运行时归因。

body.en: Updated for continuous execution and token budget.
body.zh: 更新了连续执行与 token 预算。

body.en: Updated for execution settings and billing.
body.zh: 更新了执行设定与计费。

body.en: Disposable SQLite catalog for history search.
body.zh: 可丢弃的 SQLite 历史搜索目录。

body.en: Disposable SQLite catalog for session discovery.
body.zh: 可丢弃的 SQLite 会话发现目录。

body.en: Updated for execution settings and billing.
body.zh: 更新了执行设定与计费。

body.en: Disposable SQLite catalog for tasks.
body.zh: 可丢弃的 SQLite 任务目录。

body.en: Updated for unified tool surface.
body.zh: 更新了统一工具面。

body.en: Disposable SQLite catalog for usage rollups.
body.zh: 可丢弃的 SQLite 用量汇总目录。

body.en: Crash diagnostics for Windows LTSC 2019.
body.zh: Windows LTSC 2019 崩溃诊断。

body.en: Acceptance plan for multi-currency billing.
body.zh: 多币种计费验收计划。

body.en: Goals now run until completion, a user/external blocker, an explicit stop, or an unrecoverable failure. Removed host-owned round, turn, wall-time, and stall-count pause boundaries. Added an optional goal_token_budget for token-based limits.
body.zh: 目标现在持续运行直至完成、遇到用户/外部阻塞、显式停止或不可恢复的故障。移除了主机拥有的轮次、回合、挂墙时间和停滞计数暂停边界。新增可选的 goal_token_budget 以基于 token 进行限制。

body.en: Replaced economy/full/delivery work modes with three execution settings (light, balanced, delivery) that share one provider-visible tool surface. Switch in-place via CLI /preset or desktop menu.
body.zh: 用三种执行设定（轻量、均衡、交付）取代了经济/完整/交付工作模式，共享一个供应商可见的工具面。可通过 CLI /preset 或桌面菜单原地切换。

body.en: Billing now separates model-native charges, official regional rate estimates, and display currency. Unified across Desktop, CLI, ACP, and Remote.
body.zh: 计费现在将模型原币费用、官方区域价表估值和展示币种分离。在桌面端、CLI、ACP 和 Remote 中统一。

body.en: Added cross-platform crash diagnostics and runtime attribution for Windows and Linux. Fail-open infrastructure with privacy-bounded telemetry.
body.zh: 新增了面向 Windows 和 Linux 的跨平台崩溃诊断与运行时归因。具备故障开放基础设施和隐私受限的遥测。

body.en: Stabilized native transcript scrolling, fixed auto-scroll pinning through stream end, and improved handling of variable-height content.
body.zh: 稳定了原生聊天区滚动，修复了流式输出结束时的自动滚动固定问题，并改进了对可变高度内容的处理。

body.en: Replaced duplicate Stop/Cancel controls with one accessible Stop flow. Localized task lifecycle presentation.
body.zh: 用一个可访问的停止流程替换了重复的停止/取消控件。本地化了任务生命周期展示。

title.zh: 精确自定义供应商 URL

body.en: Custom provider setup now uses one exact API address field with no path completion. Added request_url while preserving legacy chat_url.
body.zh: 自定义供应商设置现在使用一个精确的 API 地址字段，无需路径补全。新增 request_url 同时保留旧的 chat_url。

body.en: Aligned the context gauge with the compaction trigger, fixed over-limit display, and removed stale fallback values.
body.zh: 将上下文容量条与压缩触发器对齐，修复了超限显示，并移除了过时的回退值。

body.en: Localized paused Inbox errors and exposed recovery banner for ordinary paused queues. Recovered orphaned in-flight guidance.
body.zh: 本地化了暂停的收件箱错误，并为普通暂停队列提供了恢复横幅。恢复了孤立的进行中指导。

title.zh: 可丢弃的 SQLite 目录

body.en: Integrated disposable SQLite catalogs for session, history search, usage, and task domains. Authoritative data stays on disk; SQLite lives under cache and can be safely deleted.
body.zh: 集成了用于会话、历史搜索、用量和任务领域的可丢弃 SQLite 目录。权威数据保留在磁盘上；SQLite 位于缓存下，可安全删除。

title.zh: 内容驱动的上下文维护

body.en: Replaced multi-threshold auto prune/snip with a single compact_ratio (default 0.85). Checkpoint shape: stable prefix + one structured summary + recent verbatim tail.
body.zh: 用单一的 compact_ratio（默认 0.85）取代了多阈值自动修剪/裁剪。检查点形态：稳定前缀 + 一个结构化摘要 + 最近的逐字尾部。

title.en: Open with Default App in File Tree
title.zh: 文件树中用默认应用打开

body.en: Added 'Open with default app' to the workspace file tree context menu, with grouped menu items.
body.zh: 在工作区文件树右键菜单中添加了“用默认应用打开”，并对菜单项进行了分组。

body.en: Collapsed Fork, Compress, and Rewind labels to icon-only buttons by default, revealing labels on hover or focus.
body.zh: 默认将 Fork、Compress 和 Rewind 标签折叠为仅图标按钮，在悬停或聚焦时显示标签。

body.en: Replaced raw active-work errors in capability settings with localized, actionable guidance.
body.zh: 将能力设置中的原始活动工作错误替换为本地化的可操作指导。

title.en: Hide Base Providers from Plugin Model Group
title.zh: 隐藏插件模型分组中的普通供应商

body.en: Prevented unnamespaced config-backed providers from appearing in the PLUGIN group in the model picker.
body.zh: 防止未命名空间的配置支持供应商出现在模型选择器的 PLUGIN 分组中。

title.zh: 隐藏上下文检查点详情

body.en: Removed the user-facing context checkpoint detail block, preserving backend behavior.
body.zh: 移除了面向用户的上下文检查点详情块，保留后端行为。

title.zh: Windows 上目录测试兼容性

body.en: Fixed directory and permission tests to align with Windows semantics, resolving CI failures.
body.zh: 修复了目录和权限测试以符合 Windows 语义，解决了 CI 失败问题。

title.zh: 重复的 DeepSeek 迁移警告

body.en: Stopped desktop session switches from repeating misleading DeepSeek migration warnings.
body.zh: 阻止桌面会话切换时重复弹出误导性的 DeepSeek 迁移警告。

title.zh: 完成回执中的内部路由污染

body.en: Kept transient capability routing out of completion receipts, preventing misclassification of advisory conversations.
body.zh: 将内部能力路由排除在完成回执之外，防止咨询对话被错误分类。

body.en: Fixed a bug where a question queued behind another prompt was invisible, by registering before queuing.
body.zh: 修复了一个错误：排在另一个提示后面的问题不可见，通过先注册再排队解决。

body.en: Removed test-only WebView2 smoke lifecycle from the shipped executable, moving coverage to an external browser gate.
body.zh: 从发布的 EXE 中移除了仅用于测试的 WebView2 烟测生命周期，将覆盖移至外部浏览器门禁。

title.zh: Creation 外观概览主题色块

body.en: Restored hero theme swatches in Creation's AppearanceOverview that were flattened to 7px bars.
body.zh: 恢复了 Creation 外观概览中被压扁为 7px 条的 hero 主题色块。

title.en: Reasonix v1.23.0: Smarter Context, Safer Delegation, and a Smoother Desktop
title.zh: Reasonix v1.23.0：更智能的上下文、更安全的委托与更流畅的桌面体验

summary.en: This release brings a unified content-driven context maintenance system, a structured plan contract with acceptance criteria enforcement, bounded chat turns, and a durable session inbox. Desktop gains cross-message logical selection, live workspace refresh, and a three-mode reasoning display. The CLI now asks for the context window size and reports failures clearly. Many compaction, token estimation, and delegation bugs are fixed, making long sessions more predictable and cost-effective.
summary.zh: 本次更新带来了统一的内容驱动上下文维护系统、带验收标准执行的结构化计划合约、有界对话轮次以及持久化会话收件箱。桌面端新增跨消息逻辑选区、工作区实时刷新和三模式思考过程展示。CLI 现在会询问上下文窗口大小并清晰报告失败。修复了大量压缩、令牌估算和委托相关的缺陷，使长会话更可预测且更具成本效益。

body.en: Learn how to use Reasonix effectively.
body.zh: 了解如何有效使用 Reasonix。

body.en: Command-line interface documentation.
body.zh: 命令行界面文档。

body.en: Technical specification and configuration details.
body.zh: 技术规范与配置详情。

title.zh: 内容驱动的上下文维护

body.en: Replaced multi-threshold automatic context pruning with a single `compact_ratio` trigger. The system now creates a stable prefix, one structured summary, and a recent verbatim tail, preserving cache hits and reducing costs. Default ratio is 0.85.
body.zh: 用单一的 `compact_ratio` 触发器取代了多阈值自动上下文修剪。系统现在会创建稳定的前缀、一个结构化摘要和最近的逐字尾部，保留缓存命中并降低成本。默认比率为 0.85。

title.en: Structured Plan Contract with Acceptance Criteria
title.zh: 带验收标准的结构化计划合约

body.en: Plans are now structured records with stable step identities. The agent enforces acceptance criteria before completing a turn, and the plan reviewer receives a diff of changes. This ensures the agreed outcome is actually met.
body.zh: 计划现在是具有稳定步骤标识的结构化记录。Agent 在完成轮次前会强制执行验收标准，计划审核者会收到变更差异。这确保了约定的结果确实得到满足。

body.en: Ordinary chat turns now have a default ceiling of 100 model rounds to prevent runaway loops. Goal runs are bounded at 16 rounds. The system also detects structural stuck states and pauses with a resumable `goal_stuck` status.
body.zh: 普通对话轮次现在默认上限为 100 个模型轮次，以防止失控循环。Goal 运行限制为 16 轮。系统还会检测结构性卡住状态，并以可恢复的 `goal_stuck` 状态暂停。

body.en: Queued follow-ups and steer instructions are now persisted in a session-scoped inbox before acknowledgment. This prevents loss on crashes and ensures reliable recovery with paused review and capacity limits.
body.zh: 排队的后续指令和引导指令现在在确认前会持久化到会话范围的收件箱中。这可以防止崩溃时丢失，并通过暂停审核和容量限制确保可靠恢复。

title.zh: 跨消息逻辑选区（桌面端）

body.en: Selecting text across multiple messages now uses a logical selection model, keeping the DOM bounded and producing readable copy text from Markdown, LaTeX, code blocks, and tables. Single-message selection remains native.
body.zh: 跨多条消息选择文本现在使用逻辑选区模型，保持 DOM 有界，并从 Markdown、LaTeX、代码块和表格中生成可读的复制文本。单条消息选择仍为原生方式。

title.zh: 三模式思考过程展示（桌面端）

body.en: Added a persisted preference for reasoning display: hidden, summary, or auto (live-follow). Applies to main agent, work folds, and sub-agent previews. Legacy settings are migrated automatically.
body.zh: 新增持久化的思考过程展示偏好：隐藏、摘要或自动（实时跟随）。适用于主 Agent、工作折叠区和子 Agent 预览。旧设置会自动迁移。

title.zh: 工作区实时刷新（桌面端）

body.en: Workspace previews and the changes view now update immediately from agent mutation events, bounded filesystem/Git watching, and revision reconciliation, instead of waiting for turn completion.
body.zh: 工作区预览和变更视图现在会根据 Agent 变更事件、有界文件系统/Git 监视和修订协调立即更新，而无需等待轮次完成。

body.en: The custom provider wizard now asks for the context window size instead of silently assuming 128K tokens. This prevents premature compaction on models with larger windows.
body.zh: 自定义提供程序向导现在会询问上下文窗口大小，而不是默认假设为 128K 令牌。这可以防止在具有更大窗口的模型上过早压缩。

body.en: Sub-agent delegation is now a formal contract with enforced write claims, host-adjudicated completion, and detailed cost measurement. This improves safety and transparency for complex tasks.
body.zh: 子 Agent 委托现在是一个正式的合约，具有强制写入声明、主机裁决的完成和详细的成本度量。这提高了复杂任务的安全性和透明度。

body.en: Fixed several bugs that caused premature or excessive compaction: output budget collapsing thresholds, character-based token estimation, cold-start calibration loss, and context gauge mismatch. These changes make long sessions more predictable and reduce API costs.
body.zh: 修复了多个导致过早或过度压缩的缺陷：输出预算导致阈值崩溃、基于字符的令牌估算、冷启动校准丢失以及上下文仪表不匹配。这些更改使长会话更可预测，并降低了 API 成本。

body.en: Exploration now stops counting novelty as progress after six consecutive read-only rounds, allowing the no-progress guard to fire. Combined with the turn ceiling, this prevents hours-long wandering without output.
body.zh: 探索现在在连续六个只读轮次后不再将新颖性计为进展，从而允许无进展防护触发。结合轮次上限，这可以防止数小时无输出的徘徊。

body.en: Fixed an issue where delegated sub-agent calls appeared as top-level work in the transcript, and refusals were shown as successes. Now sub-calls render inside their parent, and blocked commands are correctly reported.
body.zh: 修复了委托的子 Agent 调用在对话记录中显示为顶级工作，以及拒绝被显示为成功的问题。现在子调用在其父级内部渲染，被阻止的命令会正确报告。

title.zh: 桌面任务监视器计时器冻结

body.en: Terminal task elapsed-time displays now freeze at the correct boundary, and queued tasks show a dash instead of queue age as runtime.
body.zh: 终端任务的已用时间显示现在会在正确的边界冻结，排队任务显示为破折号而不是将排队时间作为运行时间。

title.zh: Windows 资源管理器文件夹打开

body.en: Fixed a bug where 'Open in File Explorer' could launch a sibling .lnk shortcut instead of the folder. Folders now open with the `explore` verb and a trailing separator.
body.zh: 修复了“在文件资源管理器中打开”可能启动同级 .lnk 快捷方式而不是文件夹的错误。文件夹现在使用 `explore` 动词和尾部路径分隔符打开。

body.en: The CLI now always explains why a run failed, even with `-p/--print`. Previously, text output could exit with code 1 and an empty stderr.
body.zh: CLI 现在始终会解释运行失败的原因，即使使用 `-p/--print` 也是如此。以前，文本输出可能以代码 1 退出且 stderr 为空。

body.en: Removed an unnecessary full-screen clear on Windows that caused visible flicker and item jitter during transcript scrolling.
body.zh: 移除了 Windows 上不必要的全屏清除，该清除导致对话滚动时出现可见的闪烁和项目抖动。

body.en: The keep policy now correctly identifies tool failures by their structured state, not just text prefixes. This preserves specific failure evidence through compaction without doubling projection size.
body.zh: 保留策略现在通过结构化状态正确识别工具失败，而不仅仅是文本前缀。这可以在压缩过程中保留特定的失败证据，而不会使投影大小翻倍。

title.en: Hardened Desktop Build and Review Gates
title.zh: 加固的桌面构建与审核门禁

body.en: Enforced native CSS animation contracts, added WebView2 release gates, unified Wails CLI/library version pinning, and removed a cross-boundary review gate that caused false CI failures.
body.zh: 强制执行原生 CSS 动画合约，添加了 WebView2 发版门禁，统一了 Wails CLI/库版本锁定，并移除了导致虚假 CI 失败的跨边界审核门禁。

title.zh: 内容驱动的上下文维护

body.en: Single `compact_ratio` trigger with stable prefix, summary, and verbatim tail. Default 0.85.
body.zh: 单一的 `compact_ratio` 触发器，具有稳定的前缀、摘要和逐字尾部。默认 0.85。

body.en: Plans are records with stable step IDs; acceptance criteria enforced before turn completion.
body.zh: 计划是具有稳定步骤 ID 的记录；在轮次完成前强制执行验收标准。

body.en: Default 100-round ceiling for chat, 16 for Goal runs; structural stuck detection with `goal_stuck` pause.
body.zh: 对话默认 100 轮上限，Goal 运行 16 轮；结构性卡住检测，`goal_stuck` 暂停。

body.en: Persisted queued instructions with crash recovery, capacity limits, and quarantine salvage.
body.zh: 持久化排队指令，具有崩溃恢复、容量限制和隔离挽救功能。

title.zh: 跨消息逻辑选区（桌面端）

body.en: Logical selection for arbitrary loaded-history length; bounded DOM, readable copy from Markdown/LaTeX/code/tables.
body.zh: 任意已加载历史长度的逻辑选区；有界 DOM，从 Markdown/LaTeX/代码/表格中可读复制。

title.zh: 三模式思考过程展示（桌面端）

body.en: Hidden, summary, or auto (live-follow) reasoning display; legacy migration.
body.zh: 隐藏、摘要或自动（实时跟随）思考过程展示；旧版迁移。

body.en: Formal sub-agent delegation with enforced write claims, host-adjudicated completion, and cost measurement.
body.zh: 正式的子 Agent 委托，具有强制写入声明、主机裁决的完成和成本度量。

body.en: Added Flash-only presets for Anthropic Messages and Responses API with web search enabled.
body.zh: 新增仅 Flash 的 Anthropic Messages 和 Responses API 预设，并启用网络搜索。

body.en: `/context` now shows window, thresholds, last maintenance pass, and blocked reason.
body.zh: `/context` 现在显示窗口、阈值、上次维护过程和阻止原因。

title.zh: 工作区实时刷新（桌面端）

body.en: Immediate updates from agent mutations, filesystem/Git watching, and revision reconciliation.
body.zh: 根据 Agent 变更、文件系统/Git 监视和修订协调立即更新。

body.en: Wizard asks for context window size instead of assuming 128K.
body.zh: 向导询问上下文窗口大小，而不是假设 128K。

body.en: Reviewer receives a structured diff of plan changes, not just two rendered strings.
body.zh: 审核者收到计划变更的结构化差异，而不仅仅是两个渲染字符串。

body.en: Benchmarks now measure delegation independence and anchor resistance.
body.zh: 基准测试现在度量委托独立性和锚点抵抗力。

body.en: Unified Wails version pin, Node 24/pnpm 10 alignment, non-interactive installs.
body.zh: 统一 Wails 版本锁定，Node 24/pnpm 10 对齐，非交互式安装。

body.en: Output budget no longer collapses all thresholds; reserve at most 25% of window.
body.zh: 输出预算不再导致所有阈值崩溃；最多保留窗口的 25%。

body.en: Cold estimate uses characters × 0.25, not rune count; fixes 3x overestimation for CJK.
body.zh: 冷估算使用字符数 × 0.25，而不是符文数；修复了 CJK 的 3 倍高估问题。

body.en: Prompt-token calibration now persists across session rebinds (tab switch, fork, rewind).
body.zh: 提示令牌校准现在在会话重新绑定（标签切换、分支、回退）时保留。

body.en: Tool-result maintenance only runs at `compact_ratio`, preserving cache hits below fold.
body.zh: 工具结果维护仅在 `compact_ratio` 时运行，保留折叠点以下的缓存命中。

body.en: Gauge now measures the same input tokens as the compaction trigger, not last turn's usage.
body.zh: 仪表现在测量与压缩触发器相同的输入令牌，而不是上一轮的使用量。

body.en: Exploration novelty stops counting as progress after 6 read-only rounds.
body.zh: 探索新颖性在 6 个只读轮次后不再计为进展。

body.en: Sub-agent calls render inside parent; blocked commands correctly reported as not run.
body.zh: 子 Agent 调用在父级内部渲染；被阻止的命令正确报告为未运行。

title.zh: 桌面任务监视器计时器

body.en: Elapsed time freezes at terminal state; queued tasks show dash.
body.zh: 已用时间在终端状态冻结；排队任务显示破折号。

title.zh: Windows 资源管理器文件夹打开

body.en: Uses `explore` verb and trailing separator to avoid .lnk hijacking.
body.zh: 使用 `explore` 动词和尾部路径分隔符以避免 .lnk 劫持。

body.en: Always explains why a run failed, even with `-p`.
body.zh: 始终解释运行失败的原因，即使使用 `-p`。

body.en: Removed unnecessary full-screen clear on Windows.
body.zh: 移除了 Windows 上不必要的全屏清除。

body.en: Keep policy uses structured tool state, not text prefixes; preserves failures with minimal size increase.
body.zh: 保留策略使用结构化工具状态，而不是文本前缀；以最小的尺寸增加保留失败信息。

body.en: Increased timeouts for Windows test and frontend transcript harness to prevent false failures.
body.zh: 增加了 Windows 测试和前端对话记录工具的超时时间，以防止误报失败。

body.en: Legacy full-redraw workaround now limited to Warp terminal only.
body.zh: 旧版全重绘解决方法现在仅限于 Warp 终端。

body.en: Increased test timeouts and fixed session inbox/hook tests for Windows.
body.zh: 增加了测试超时时间，并修复了 Windows 上的会话收件箱/钩子测试。

summary.en: Desktop session durability, context maintenance, and workspace improvements, plus CLI web handoff and provider output budget fixes.
summary.zh: 桌面端会话持久性、上下文维护和工作区改进，以及 CLI Web 交接和提供商输出预算修复。

body.en: Use `reasonix web` to start a local web interface and `/web` to hand off an active CLI session to a browser.
body.zh: 使用 `reasonix web` 启动本地 Web 界面，使用 `/web` 将活动 CLI 会话交接至浏览器。

body.en: Native v2 plugins now require explicit resource declarations in `reasonix-plugin.json`.
body.zh: 原生 v2 插件现在需要在 `reasonix-plugin.json` 中显式声明资源。

title.en: Desktop topic archive no longer hangs
title.zh: 桌面端话题归档不再卡死

body.en: Archiving a topic now returns promptly and shows per-topic progress, preventing silent failures and UI freezes.
body.zh: 归档话题现在会立即返回并显示每个话题的进度，防止静默失败和界面冻结。

title.zh: 会话 sidecar 文件现已持久化

body.en: Title and display sidecars use atomic writes with fsync and cross-process locking to prevent data loss on crash.
body.zh: 标题和显示 sidecar 文件使用带 fsync 的原子写入和跨进程锁，防止崩溃时数据丢失。

title.zh: 上下文维护现已投影幂等

body.en: Automatic context cleanup no longer repeatedly processes the same tool results, and summary transactions are atomic.
body.zh: 自动上下文清理不再重复处理相同的工具结果，摘要事务现在是原子的。

body.en: Use `reasonix web` to start a local web interface and `/web` to hand off an active CLI session to a browser.
body.zh: 使用 `reasonix web` 启动本地 Web 界面，使用 `/web` 将活动 CLI 会话交接至浏览器。

body.en: Requests near the context window limit now clip the output budget to avoid HTTP 400 errors.
body.zh: 接近上下文窗口限制的请求现在会裁剪输出预算，避免 HTTP 400 错误。

title.en: Status bar TPS updates after each request
title.zh: 状态栏 TPS 每次请求后更新

body.en: Throughput in the status bar now refreshes after every provider request instead of only at turn completion.
body.zh: 状态栏中的吞吐量现在在每次提供商请求后刷新，而不仅仅在回合完成时。

body.en: Right-click a file or folder in the workspace tree to copy its relative or absolute path.
body.zh: 在工作区树中右键单击文件或文件夹，即可复制其相对或绝对路径。

title.zh: 修复旧版 Windows 快捷方式

body.en: Shortcuts from older versions now self-heal their icon and target paths after migration to the versioned layout.
body.zh: 旧版本的快捷方式现在在迁移到版本化布局后会自动修复其图标和目标路径。

body.en: Browser spellcheck, autocorrect, and autocapitalization are now disabled in the composer to avoid misleading underlines.
body.zh: 输入框中现已禁用浏览器拼写检查、自动更正和自动大写，以避免误导性下划线。

title.zh: 精简空闲 SSH 状态栏

body.en: Disconnected SSH status now shows a compact label or icon, saving space while keeping full status accessible.
body.zh: 断开连接的 SSH 状态现在显示精简标签或图标，节省空间同时保持完整状态可访问。

title.en: Native v2 plugin resources are now explicit
title.zh: 原生 v2 插件资源改为显式声明

body.en: Native v2 plugins no longer implicitly import Claude compatibility resources; all resources must be declared in the manifest.
body.zh: 原生 v2 插件不再隐式导入 Claude 兼容资源；所有资源必须在清单中声明。

title.zh: 加固核心数据安全路径

body.en: Shell output is bounded, corrupted sessions remain visible, and metadata backfill is race-safe.
body.zh: Shell 输出受到限制，损坏的会话保持可见，元数据回填是竞态安全的。

title.zh: 为 Global 工作区启用外部打开按钮

body.en: Global tabs with a valid local workspace now show the external opener button.
body.zh: 具有有效本地工作区的 Global 标签页现在显示外部打开按钮。

title.en: Wails CLI and library version unified
title.zh: 统一 Wails CLI 与依赖版本锁定

body.en: A single `.wails-version` pin now ensures consistent Wails toolchain across CI, builds, and contributor setups.
body.zh: 现在通过单一的 `.wails-version` 锁定文件确保 CI、构建和贡献者环境中的 Wails 工具链一致。

body.en: Added `reasonix web` command and `/web` slash command to hand off CLI sessions to a browser.
body.zh: 新增 `reasonix web` 命令和 `/web` 斜杠命令，用于将 CLI 会话交接至浏览器。

body.en: Added Copy relative path and Copy absolute path to the workspace file-tree context menu.
body.zh: 在工作区文件树右键菜单中新增“复制相对路径”和“复制绝对路径”。

body.en: Title and display sidecars now use atomic writes with fsync and cross-process locking.
body.zh: 标题和显示 sidecar 文件现在使用带 fsync 的原子写入和跨进程锁。

body.en: Throughput now updates after each provider request instead of only at turn completion.
body.zh: 吞吐量现在在每次提供商请求后更新，而不仅仅在回合完成时。

title.zh: 精简空闲 SSH 状态栏

body.en: Disconnected SSH status shows a compact label or icon to save space.
body.zh: 断开连接的 SSH 状态显示精简标签或图标以节省空间。

body.en: Bounded shell output, visible corrupted sessions, and race-safe metadata backfill.
body.zh: 限制 Shell 输出、损坏会话可见以及竞态安全的元数据回填。

body.en: A single `.wails-version` pin ensures consistent Wails toolchain across environments.
body.zh: 通过单一的 `.wails-version` 锁定文件确保各环境中 Wails 工具链一致。

body.en: Archiving a topic no longer hangs or silently ignores clicks.
body.zh: 归档话题不再卡死或静默忽略点击。

body.en: Automatic cleanup no longer repeatedly processes the same tool results.
body.zh: 自动清理不再重复处理相同的工具结果。

body.en: Requests near the context window limit now clip the output budget to avoid HTTP 400 errors.
body.zh: 接近上下文窗口限制的请求现在会裁剪输出预算，避免 HTTP 400 错误。

title.zh: 修复旧版 Windows 快捷方式

body.en: Shortcuts from older versions self-heal their icon and target paths after migration.
body.zh: 旧版本的快捷方式在迁移后会自动修复其图标和目标路径。

body.en: Browser spellcheck, autocorrect, and autocapitalization are now disabled in the composer.
body.zh: 输入框中现已禁用浏览器拼写检查、自动更正和自动大写。

title.zh: 原生 v2 插件资源显式声明

body.en: Native v2 plugins no longer implicitly import Claude compatibility resources.
body.zh: 原生 v2 插件不再隐式导入 Claude 兼容资源。

title.zh: Global 工作区外部打开按钮

body.en: Global tabs with a valid local workspace now show the external opener button.
body.zh: 具有有效本地工作区的 Global 标签页现在显示外部打开按钮。

summary.en: Faster session switching, stable WebView2 animations, and completion receipts that show what changed.
summary.zh: 更快的会话切换、稳定的 WebView2 动画，以及显示变更内容的完成回执。

title.zh: 修复 WebView2 动画崩溃

body.en: Replaced GSAP-specific motion helpers with CSS-compatible Web Animations tokens. Approval, collapse, and entrance animations now fail gracefully when WebView2 rejects or cancels an animation, preventing fatal errors.
body.zh: 将 GSAP 专用的动画辅助函数替换为兼容 CSS 的 Web Animations 标记。当 WebView2 拒绝或取消动画时，批准、折叠和入场动画现在会优雅降级，避免致命错误。

body.en: Reduced duplicate backend calls during session switches. The project tree no longer refetches on every switch, and read-only queries are coalesced within a 200ms window, cutting IPC time by up to 35%.
body.zh: 减少了会话切换时的重复后端调用。项目树不再在每次切换时重新获取，只读查询在 200 毫秒窗口内合并，IPC 时间最多减少 35%。

title.zh: 完成回执显示变更内容

body.en: The completion report now includes changed paths, verification commands and outcomes, and gap details. Delivered via TurnDone and eventwire, so streaming JSON and frontends receive it automatically.
body.zh: 完成报告现在包含变更路径、验证命令及其结果，以及差距详情。通过 TurnDone 和 eventwire 传递，流式 JSON 和前端会自动接收。

body.en: TurnDone now includes a receipt with changed paths, verification commands, and gap details. Empty turns produce no receipt.
body.zh: TurnDone 现在包含回执，其中包含变更路径、验证命令和差距详情。空回合不产生回执。

body.en: Duplicate backend calls are coalesced within a 200ms window, and the project tree no longer refetches on every session switch.
body.zh: 在 200 毫秒窗口内合并重复的后端调用，项目树不再在每次会话切换时重新获取。

body.en: GSAP easing tokens replaced with CSS-compatible syntax. Animations fail open when WebView2 rejects them, preventing fatal errors.
body.zh: 将 GSAP 缓动标记替换为兼容 CSS 的语法。当 WebView2 拒绝动画时，动画会优雅降级，避免致命错误。

title.en: Reasonix v1.21.4: Memory Dimensions, Completion Contracts, and Desktop Refinements
title.zh: Reasonix v1.21.4：记忆维度、完成契约与桌面体验优化

summary.en: This release introduces completion contracts that make goal claims verifiable against receipts. Memory gains activation, volatility, subject keys, and CJK bigram retrieval. Desktop optimizations include session-switch performance, local file link handling, and IME-aware ESC behavior. Agent improvements bring incremental fold digest carry, compaction bounds, and a reasoning governor shadow mode.
summary.zh: 本次发布引入完成契约，使目标声明可对照收据进行核查。记忆功能新增激活、易变性、主题键和 CJK 双字检索。桌面端优化了会话切换性能、本地文件链接处理和输入法感知的 ESC 行为。智能体改进包括增量折叠摘要携带、压缩边界和推理调控器影子模式。

title.zh: 完成契约：可核查的目标声明

body.en: Goal completion now carries verifiable claims. Verified commands are reconciled against receipts; unbacked claims become gaps. Host-generated completion reports show missing proof without forcing verification loops.
body.zh: 目标完成现在携带可核查的声明。已验证的命令会与收据进行核对；无依据的声明会变成缺口。由主机生成的完成报告会显示缺失的证明，而不会强制进行验证循环。

title.en: Memory Dimensions: Activation, Volatility, and Subject Keys
title.zh: 记忆维度：激活、易变性与主题键

body.en: Facts can be pinned to the stable prefix or used only for retrieval. Volatility windows (evergreen/stable/volatile) and expiry dates control freshness. Subject keys prevent silent contradictions by allowing only one active value per question.
body.zh: 事实可以固定到稳定前缀，或仅用于检索。易变性窗口（永久/稳定/易变）和过期日期控制新鲜度。主题键通过每个问题只允许一个活跃值来防止静默矛盾。

title.en: Desktop: Session Switch Performance and Local File Links
title.zh: 桌面端：会话切换性能与本地文件链接

body.en: Large session histories and rapid topic switches no longer block the renderer. Local file paths in agent output are clickable to open, with right-click options for other apps and file manager.
body.zh: 大型会话历史和快速主题切换不再阻塞渲染器。智能体输出中的本地文件路径可点击打开，右键菜单提供其他应用和文件管理器选项。

title.en: Agent: Incremental Fold Digest Carry and Compaction Bounds
title.zh: 智能体：增量折叠摘要携带与压缩边界

body.en: Incremental folds now carry previous digests verbatim, recovering 17 of 18 lost probes. Compaction inputs are bounded, ensuring long sessions can always fold and preventing session wedging.
body.zh: 增量折叠现在逐字携带之前的摘要，恢复了 18 个丢失探针中的 17 个。压缩输入有边界，确保长会话始终可以折叠，防止会话卡死。

title.en: Desktop: IME-Aware ESC and Selection Release
title.zh: 桌面端：输入法感知的 ESC 与选区释放

body.en: Pressing ESC while an IME candidate window is open no longer cancels a running agent turn. Stale transcript selections are released on new clicks, and Add to Chat preserves the selection range during activation.
body.zh: 在输入法候选窗口打开时按 ESC 不再取消正在运行的智能体回合。过时的聊天记录选区会在新点击时释放，添加到聊天操作在激活期间保留选区范围。

body.en: Goal completion claims are now verifiable. The host-authored completion report identifies gaps between claims and receipts, making premature 'done' declarations transparent.
body.zh: 目标完成声明现在可核查。主机生成的完成报告可识别声明与收据之间的缺口，使过早的“完成”声明透明化。

body.en: Facts can be pinned to the stable prefix or used only for retrieval. Subject keys prevent contradictory facts on the same topic.
body.zh: 事实可固定到稳定前缀或仅用于检索。主题键可防止同一主题出现矛盾事实。

body.en: Facts now support volatility windows (evergreen/stable/volatile) and explicit expiry dates for freshness control.
body.zh: 事实现在支持易变性窗口（永久/稳定/易变）和明确的过期日期，以控制新鲜度。

title.en: CJK Bigram Retrieval and Write-Time Keywords
title.zh: CJK 双字检索与写入时关键词

body.en: Memory retrieval now uses CJK bigrams for better matching, and facts can include write-time keywords for semantic bridging.
body.zh: 记忆检索现在使用 CJK 双字以改善匹配，事实可包含写入时关键词以实现语义桥接。

body.en: A model-callable `compress` tool allows explicit range compaction without rewriting the canonical transcript.
body.zh: 模型可调用的 `compress` 工具允许显式范围压缩，而无需重写规范记录。

title.zh: MCP OAuth 与失败感知路由

body.en: First-party OAuth authorization for remote MCP servers, with sandbox-safe credential storage and failure-aware tool routing.
body.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器的第一方 OAuth 授权，具有沙箱安全的凭据存储和失败感知的工具路由。

title.zh: 代际安全的运行时组合

body.en: Runtime composition with dependency graphs, lifecycle states, and atomic publish/commit for multi-session isolation.
body.zh: 具有依赖图、生命周期状态和原子发布/提交的运行时组合，用于多会话隔离。

body.en: Collapsed reasoning traces now show a preview line, with full Markdown rendering deferred until expansion.
body.zh: 折叠的推理轨迹现在显示预览行，完整的 Markdown 渲染延迟到展开时。

title.en: Desktop Status Bar: TPS, Cache, and Output Tokens
title.zh: 桌面状态栏：TPS、缓存和输出令牌

body.en: Configurable status bar items show turn throughput, cache token counts, and output tokens.
body.zh: 可配置的状态栏项目显示回合吞吐量、缓存令牌计数和输出令牌。

body.en: A shadow reasoning governor measures exploration-phase efficiency without enforcing policy, preparing for future optimization.
body.zh: 影子推理调控器在不强制执行策略的情况下测量探索阶段效率，为未来优化做准备。

title.zh: 先验证再变更提示（实验性）

body.en: An env-gated nudge encourages verification after several blind mutations, available for experimentation.
body.zh: 环境门控的提示在多次盲目变更后鼓励验证，可供实验使用。

body.en: Shadow telemetry tracks how long mutations sit unverified, providing data for future policy decisions.
body.zh: 影子遥测跟踪变更未验证的时长，为未来策略决策提供数据。

title.en: Shadow Admission Control for Research Delegation
title.zh: 研究委托的影子准入控制

body.en: Shadow measurement of research delegation calls identifies unnecessary subagent usage without blocking.
body.zh: 研究委托调用的影子测量可识别不必要的子代理使用，而不会阻止。

body.en: Trajectory digests now include per-round token usage and slow-round census for performance analysis.
body.zh: 轨迹摘要现在包括每轮令牌使用情况和慢轮统计，用于性能分析。

body.en: A shadow scorer decomposes per-round outcomes (exploration, verification, churn) to measure progress quality.
body.zh: 影子评分器分解每轮结果（探索、验证、变动）以衡量进展质量。

title.zh: 资格点反事实分叉框架

body.en: Infrastructure for causal experiments by forking identical states into control and treatment arms.
body.zh: 通过将相同状态分叉为对照组和处理组来进行因果实验的基础设施。

title.zh: 验证压力基准测试套件

body.en: A benchmark suite measuring EBM trigger precision across positive, neutral, and negative scenarios.
body.zh: 一个基准测试套件，用于测量 EBM 触发器在正面、中性和负面场景中的精度。

body.en: A benchmark harness measuring memory utility delta with counterfactual arms and point-of-use markers.
body.zh: 一个基准测试框架，通过反事实臂和使用点标记测量记忆效用增量。

title.en: CompactionBench: Cost and Fidelity of Repeated Folds
title.zh: CompactionBench：重复折叠的成本与保真度

body.en: A benchmark measuring the cost and information loss of repeated session folding.
body.zh: 一个基准测试，用于测量重复会话折叠的成本和信息丢失。

body.en: A local dashboard for live e2ebench runs with per-round traces and replay.
body.zh: 一个本地仪表板，用于实时 e2ebench 运行，具有每轮跟踪和回放功能。

body.en: A shadow retrieval system with BM25F, code symbols, and mixed CJK grams, measured against production BM25.
body.zh: 一个影子检索系统，具有 BM25F、代码符号和混合 CJK 分词，与生产 BM25 进行对比测量。

title.en: Session Recall Index and Crash-Safe Writers
title.zh: 会话召回索引与防崩溃写入器

body.en: Memory recall now uses a prebuilt index for zero disk IO per turn, with atomic file writes for durability.
body.zh: 记忆召回现在使用预构建索引，实现每轮零磁盘 IO，并通过原子文件写入确保持久性。

title.zh: Goal 成为唯一长任务运行时

body.en: Goal is now the only long-running task state machine; AutoResearch is reduced to a read-only compatibility reader.
body.zh: Goal 现在是唯一的长任务状态机；AutoResearch 降级为只读兼容性读取器。

title.zh: 推荐 DeepSeek Anthropic 接入

body.en: Fresh installs now default to the official DeepSeek Anthropic Messages endpoint, with legacy migration for existing configurations.
body.zh: 全新安装现在默认使用官方 DeepSeek Anthropic Messages 端点，并为现有配置提供旧版迁移。

body.en: Desktop skills settings now match the MCP model, with implicit skill discovery as an explicit runtime policy.
body.zh: 桌面技能设置现在与 MCP 模型匹配，隐式技能发现作为显式运行时策略。

body.en: New animated SVG logo variants and updated README banner.
body.zh: 新的动画 SVG Logo 变体和更新的 README 横幅。

body.en: Redesigned homepage hero install section with particles, unified fonts, and refreshed brand assets.
body.zh: 重新设计的首页 hero 安装部分，包含粒子效果、统一字体和更新的品牌资源。

body.en: Large histories and rapid topic switches no longer block the renderer, with virtual list and worker-based Markdown parsing.
body.zh: 大型历史和快速主题切换不再阻塞渲染器，采用虚拟列表和基于 Worker 的 Markdown 解析。

body.en: Local file paths in agent output are now clickable to open with the default app, with right-click context menu options.
body.zh: 智能体输出中的本地文件路径现在可点击以默认应用打开，并提供右键上下文菜单选项。

body.en: Incremental folds now carry previous digests verbatim, recovering most lost probes and maintaining O(1) fold cost.
body.zh: 增量折叠现在逐字携带之前的摘要，恢复了大部分丢失的探针，并保持 O(1) 折叠成本。

body.en: Summarizer input is now bounded, preventing session wedging by partitioning oversized folds.
body.zh: 摘要器输入现在有边界，通过分区超大折叠防止会话卡死。

body.en: The provider-visible memory index now uses scope-qualified references and annotates overrides, aligning with recall precedence.
body.zh: 提供者可见的记忆索引现在使用作用域限定的引用并注释覆盖，与召回优先级保持一致。

title.en: Desktop Edit Actions for Cancelled Turns
title.zh: 取消回合的桌面编辑操作

body.en: Cancelled turns now preserve edit, rewind, fork, and summary actions by rehydrating authoritative history.
body.zh: 取消的回合现在通过重新加载权威历史来保留编辑、回退、分叉和摘要操作。

body.en: Context-dependent tools are now gated before execution, with child agent isolation and migration boundary fixes.
body.zh: 上下文相关工具现在在执行前进行门控，并修复了子代理隔离和迁移边界问题。

title.zh: 崩溃恢复 WAL 感知

body.en: Session persistence is now CAS/WAL-protected, preventing stale overwrites and ensuring monotonic state.
body.zh: 会话持久化现在受 CAS/WAL 保护，防止过时覆盖并确保状态单调。

title.zh: 压缩折叠区域分区修复

body.en: The fold region is now correctly partitioned, preventing user-stated constraints from being dropped.
body.zh: 折叠区域现在正确分区，防止用户声明的约束被丢弃。

body.en: Fixed seeding and audit forwarding bugs, enabling the first real memory utility baseline.
body.zh: 修复了种子和审计转发错误，实现了第一个真实的内存效用基线。

body.en: Batched Dependabot upgrades for desktop frontend, site, and Go dependencies.
body.zh: 批量 Dependabot 升级桌面前端、网站和 Go 依赖。

title.en: CI Linter and Windows Timeout Fixes
title.zh: CI 检查器和 Windows 超时修复

body.en: Local linting now matches CI, and Windows smoke test timeouts are increased to handle runner variance.
body.zh: 本地检查现在与 CI 匹配，Windows 冒烟测试超时增加以应对运行器差异。

body.en: Fixed the homepage header logo rendering as a large square by declaring SVG intrinsic dimensions.
body.zh: 通过声明 SVG 固有尺寸，修复了首页头部 Logo 渲染为大正方形的问题。

title.zh: 输入法感知的 ESC 行为

body.en: Pressing ESC while an IME candidate window is open no longer cancels a running agent turn.
body.zh: 在输入法候选窗口打开时按 ESC 不再取消正在运行的智能体回合。

body.en: Stale transcript selections are now released on new clicks, and Add to Chat preserves the selection range during activation.
body.zh: 过时的聊天记录选区现在会在新点击时释放，添加到聊天操作在激活期间保留选区范围。

body.en: Hardened two tests that failed on Windows due to timing races on loaded CI runners.
body.zh: 加固了两个因 CI 运行器负载导致时序竞争而在 Windows 上失败的测试。

body.en: Made three CI-red tests deterministic across platforms by gating Unix-specific assertions and skipping on Windows.
body.zh: 通过门控 Unix 特定断言并在 Windows 上跳过，使三个 CI 红色测试跨平台具有确定性。

summary.en: This release brings Markdown rendering to thinking traces, explicit Kimi K3 reasoning for custom gateways, visible storage paths, adaptive no-progress guard, and fixes for Windows install behavior, taskbar grouping, retry-inflated compaction, and stream coalescing.
summary.zh: 此版本为思考过程带来 Markdown 渲染，为自定义网关提供显式 Kimi K3 推理支持，新增存储路径展示与自适应无进展防护，并修复 Windows 安装位置、任务栏分组、重试导致的提前压缩以及流合并问题。

title.zh: 自定义 Kimi K3 网关设置

body.en: Learn how to configure a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway to use the Kimi K3 reasoning protocol.
body.zh: 了解如何配置自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关以使用 Kimi K3 推理协议。

title.zh: 自定义 Kimi K3 网关设置（中文）

body.en: Learn how to configure a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway to use the Kimi K3 reasoning protocol.
body.zh: 了解如何配置自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关以使用 Kimi K3 推理协议。

title.en: Thinking traces now render as Markdown
title.zh: 思考过程现在以 Markdown 渲染

body.en: Reasoning panels, folded turns, and sub-agent previews now correctly display headings, emphasis, lists, and code blocks. Streaming stops immediately after reasoning completes, and hidden content stays lightweight.
body.zh: 推理面板、折叠轮次和子代理预览现在可以正确显示标题、强调、列表和代码块。推理完成后立即停止流式传输，隐藏内容保持轻量。

title.en: Storage paths are visible and Windows keeps its install location
title.zh: 存储路径可见，Windows 保留安装位置

body.en: Settings now shows the runtime-owned workspace, session and memory, cache, and extension paths as read-only values. Windows installs and updates continue using the user's existing install directory.
body.zh: 设置中现在会以只读方式显示运行时实际使用的工作区、会话与记忆、缓存和扩展路径。Windows 安装与更新会继续使用用户现有的安装目录。

title.en: Explicit Kimi K3 reasoning for custom gateways
title.zh: 自定义网关的显式 Kimi K3 推理

body.en: Custom OpenAI-compatible gateways can now select the Kimi K3 reasoning protocol directly in the provider editor. Reasoning history is preserved, and the curated OpenCode Go relay remains unchanged.
body.zh: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关现在可以在提供商编辑器中直接选择 Kimi K3 推理协议。推理历史得以保留，精选的 OpenCode Go 中继保持不变。

title.zh: 修复 Windows 任务栏图标分组

body.en: Launching from a pinned shortcut now reuses the pinned icon instead of creating a second one. Existing shortcuts are repaired automatically, and the 0.53 build keeps its separate identity.
body.zh: 从固定快捷方式启动现在会重用固定图标，而不是创建第二个图标。现有快捷方式会自动修复，0.53 版本保持独立身份。

title.zh: 修复重试导致的提前压缩决策

body.en: Automatic compaction now uses the latest single-request prompt size, preventing premature context folding when stream interruptions cause multiple attempts. Billing totals remain accurate.
body.zh: 自动压缩现在使用最新的单次请求提示大小，防止流中断导致多次尝试时过早折叠上下文。计费总额保持准确。

title.en: Adaptive no-progress guard replaces fixed round count
title.zh: 自适应无进展防护取代固定轮次计数

body.en: The agent now escalates only when consecutive rounds add no new evidence; any progress resets the streak. This prevents unnecessary nudges and forced stops while progress is being made.
body.zh: 代理现在仅在连续轮次未添加新证据时升级，任何进展都会重置。这可以防止在取得进展时进行不必要的提示和强制停止。

title.en: Stream coalescing now active on the hot path
title.zh: 流合并现在在热路径上生效

body.en: Fixed a wiring issue so that the agent's token bursts are properly merged before reaching the frontend, reducing UI jitter and event volume.
body.zh: 修复了接线问题，确保代理的令牌突发在到达前端之前正确合并，减少 UI 抖动和事件量。

title.en: Explicit Kimi K3 reasoning for custom gateways
title.zh: 自定义网关的显式 Kimi K3 推理

body.en: Custom OpenAI-compatible gateways can now select the Kimi K3 reasoning protocol directly in the provider editor. Reasoning history is preserved, and the curated OpenCode Go relay remains unchanged.
body.zh: 自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关现在可以在提供商编辑器中直接选择 Kimi K3 推理协议。推理历史得以保留，精选的 OpenCode Go 中继保持不变。

title.en: Thinking traces now render as Markdown
title.zh: 思考过程现在以 Markdown 渲染

body.en: Reasoning panels, folded turns, and sub-agent previews now correctly display headings, emphasis, lists, and code blocks. Streaming stops immediately after reasoning completes, and hidden content stays lightweight.
body.zh: 推理面板、折叠轮次和子代理预览现在可以正确显示标题、强调、列表和代码块。推理完成后立即停止流式传输，隐藏内容保持轻量。

title.en: Storage paths are visible and Windows keeps its install location
title.zh: 存储路径可见，Windows 保留安装位置

body.en: Settings now shows the runtime-owned workspace, session and memory, cache, and extension paths as read-only values. Windows installs and updates continue using the user's existing install directory.
body.zh: 设置中现在会以只读方式显示运行时实际使用的工作区、会话与记忆、缓存和扩展路径。Windows 安装与更新会继续使用用户现有的安装目录。

title.en: Adaptive no-progress guard replaces fixed round count
title.zh: 自适应无进展防护取代固定轮次计数

body.en: The agent now escalates only when consecutive rounds add no new evidence; any progress resets the streak. This prevents unnecessary nudges and forced stops while progress is being made.
body.zh: 代理现在仅在连续轮次未添加新证据时升级，任何进展都会重置。这可以防止在取得进展时进行不必要的提示和强制停止。

title.zh: 修复 Windows 任务栏图标分组

body.en: Launching from a pinned shortcut now reuses the pinned icon instead of creating a second one. Existing shortcuts are repaired automatically, and the 0.53 build keeps its separate identity.
body.zh: 从固定快捷方式启动现在会重用固定图标，而不是创建第二个图标。现有快捷方式会自动修复，0.53 版本保持独立身份。

title.zh: 修复重试导致的提前压缩决策

body.en: Automatic compaction now uses the latest single-request prompt size, preventing premature context folding when stream interruptions cause multiple attempts. Billing totals remain accurate.
body.zh: 自动压缩现在使用最新的单次请求提示大小，防止流中断导致多次尝试时过早折叠上下文。计费总额保持准确。

title.en: Stream coalescing now active on the hot path
title.zh: 流合并现在在热路径上生效

body.en: Fixed a wiring issue so that the agent's token bursts are properly merged before reaching the frontend, reducing UI jitter and event volume.
body.zh: 修复了接线问题，确保代理的令牌突发在到达前端之前正确合并，减少 UI 抖动和事件量。

title.en: Reasonix v1.21.2: Output Budgets, Cache-Aware Context, and Agent Hardening
title.zh: Reasonix v1.21.2：输出预算提升、缓存感知上下文与 Agent 加固

summary.en: This release raises output budgets to 128K, introduces cache-aware context projection for more efficient history management, hardens agent behavior with work-practice policies, and fixes issues in file tools, sandbox detection, hooks, and updates.
summary.zh: 此版本将输出预算提升至 128K，引入缓存感知上下文投影以更高效管理历史，通过工作实践策略加固 Agent 行为，并修复了文件工具、沙箱检测、钩子和更新等方面的诸多问题。

body.en: Learn how to use the Agent Communication Protocol for editor integration.
body.zh: 了解如何使用 Agent 通信协议进行编辑器集成。

body.en: Chinese version of the ACP guide.
body.zh: ACP 指南的中文版本。

body.en: Guide for configuring and using desktop hooks.
body.zh: 配置和使用桌面钩子的指南。

body.en: Comprehensive guide to using Reasonix.
body.zh: 使用 Reasonix 的综合指南。

body.en: Chinese version of the user guide.
body.zh: 用户指南的中文版本。

body.en: Documentation for creating and managing plugin packages.
body.zh: 创建和管理插件包的文档。

body.en: Chinese version of the plugin packages documentation.
body.zh: 插件包文档的中文版本。

body.en: Steps to recover from stuck updates and other issues.
body.zh: 从卡住的更新和其他问题中恢复的步骤。

body.en: Chinese version of the recovery guide.
body.zh: 恢复指南的中文版本。

body.en: Technical specification for Reasonix.
body.zh: Reasonix 的技术规范。

body.en: Research document on cache-aware context projection.
body.zh: 关于缓存感知上下文投影的研究文档。

title.en: Raised output budgets to 128K with cache-aware context projection
title.zh: 输出预算提升至 128K，并引入缓存感知上下文投影

body.en: Provider-scoped output budgets now support 128K-class reasoning ceilings for compatible providers. Cache-aware context projection separates durable history from the model-visible request, preserving the canonical transcript and using cache state only for cost strategy. Cold/warm/unknown resume no longer rewrites history.
body.zh: 支持 provider 的默认输出预算提升至 128K。缓存感知上下文投影将持久历史与模型可见请求分离，保留完整 canonical transcript，缓存状态仅用于成本策略。冷/热/未知恢复不再重写历史。

title.zh: 工作实践策略加固 Agent 行为

body.en: A new work-practice policy is appended to every system prompt, ensuring the agent implements the requested approach exactly, keeps scratch out of the repo, and scales verification to the change size. This applies to all runs, not just benchmarks.
body.zh: 新增工作实践策略，附加到每个系统提示中，确保 Agent 严格实现所请求的方法、不将临时文件留在仓库中，并根据变更规模调整验证范围。适用于所有运行，而非仅基准测试。

title.en: Streaming performance: coalesced deltas and per-block Markdown parsing
title.zh: 流式性能提升：合并增量与按块解析 Markdown

body.en: Streaming deltas are now coalesced before reaching the frontend, reducing IPC overhead. Markdown is parsed per completed block instead of per tick, cutting parse count dramatically for typical answers. Frame deltas are folded into one reducer pass per tab, lowering UI thread load.
body.zh: 流式增量在到达前端前合并，减少 IPC 开销。Markdown 按已完成块解析而非每次 tick 解析，大幅降低典型回答的解析次数。每帧增量合并为每个标签页一次 reducer 处理，降低 UI 线程负载。

title.en: File tools now route through FileOverlay and writes are atomic
title.zh: 文件工具通过 FileOverlay 路由，写入操作原子化

body.en: All file-editing tools (edit_file, multi_edit, delete_range, etc.) now respect the host FileOverlay, preventing overwrites of unsaved editor buffers. File writes are atomic, using temp-file-and-rename to avoid corruption on crash.
body.zh: 所有文件编辑工具（edit_file、multi_edit、delete_range 等）现在遵循宿主 FileOverlay，防止覆盖未保存的编辑器缓冲区。文件写入采用临时文件加重命名的原子操作，避免崩溃时损坏。

title.en: Sandbox detection probes usability, not just PATH presence
title.zh: 沙箱检测探测可用性，而非仅检查 PATH 存在

body.en: On macOS, sandbox-exec availability is now probed with a minimal profile, correctly reporting unavailability on restricted systems where it exists but cannot apply sandboxing. This prevents silent enforcement failures.
body.zh: 在 macOS 上，现在通过最小配置文件探测 sandbox-exec 的可用性，正确报告在受限系统上不可用的情况（存在但无法应用沙箱），防止静默执行失败。

title.en: Self-healing stuck pending updates and version normalization
title.zh: 自愈卡住的待更新事务与版本号归一化

body.en: Stuck in-app updates now self-heal: stale probationary updates auto-commit after 24h, version comparison normalizes leading 'v', and a new 'Discard previous update' button allows manual recovery. Recovery docs updated.
body.zh: 卡住的应用内更新现在可自愈：过期的试用更新在 24 小时后自动提交，版本比较归一化前导 'v'，新增「放弃上次更新」按钮允许手动恢复。更新了恢复文档。

title.en: Prevent stale results after reasoning-only stops
title.zh: 防止仅推理停止后出现陈旧结果

body.en: Internal consumers like sub-agents and planners now require a visible final answer. Reasoning-only stops trigger a bounded retry, and cleanup is compaction-aware, preserving completed evidence. Guardian reviews fail closed after empty finals.
body.zh: 子代理和规划器等内部消费者现在要求可见的最终答案。仅推理停止会触发有限重试，清理操作感知压缩，保留已完成的证据。Guardian 审查在空最终结果后安全关闭。

title.en: Windows POSIX hook scripts normalized across sources
title.zh: Windows 多来源 Hook 的 POSIX 脚本执行归一化

body.en: POSIX shebang scripts from plugins, projects, and global hooks on Windows are now detected and routed through Git Bash. Paths are normalized, and Bash dependencies are visible to diagnostics.
body.zh: Windows 上来自插件、项目和全局钩子的 POSIX shebang 脚本现在被检测并通过 Git Bash 执行。路径已归一化，Bash 依赖项对诊断可见。

title.en: UI latency telemetry with performance budgets
title.zh: 带性能预算的 UI 延迟遥测

body.en: Desktop now records UI latency metrics (frame duration, input latency, markdown parse time, etc.) via anonymous counters, with documented performance budgets. No message content is collected.
body.zh: 桌面版现在通过匿名计数器记录 UI 延迟指标（帧持续时间、输入延迟、Markdown 解析时间等），并附有文档化的性能预算。不收集消息内容。

title.en: Per-task trajectory recording and wall-time attribution
title.zh: 按任务轨迹记录与耗时归因

body.en: The CLI and benchmark harness can now record per-task event trajectories (--trajectory) and attribute wall time to tools vs. model thinking. Reports include time attribution when trajectories are recorded.
body.zh: CLI 和基准测试工具现在可以记录每个任务的事件轨迹（--trajectory），并将耗时归因于工具执行与模型思考。记录轨迹时，报告包含时间归因。

title.en: Tool result timestamps for time attribution
title.zh: 工具结果时间戳用于耗时归因

body.en: Tool results now carry absolute start/end timestamps, enabling reconstruction of where a turn's time went. Cancelled or skipped calls carry zero timestamps.
body.zh: 工具结果现在携带绝对开始/结束时间戳，可重建回合时间分配。已取消或跳过的调用时间戳为零。

title.en: Linting and code quality gates expanded
title.zh: 代码检查与质量门禁扩展

body.en: Function size and complexity are now gated in CI. File-size ceiling extended to TypeScript. All build tags are linted across platforms. Modern Go idioms adopted and enforced.
body.zh: 函数大小和复杂度现在在 CI 中设限。文件大小上限扩展到 TypeScript。所有构建标签跨平台检查。采用并强制执行现代 Go 惯用法。

body.en: All error comparisons now use errors.Is/As through the unwrap chain, preventing silent breakage when errors are wrapped. Hand-rolled unwrap helpers removed.
body.zh: 所有错误比较现在通过解包链使用 errors.Is/As，防止包装错误时静默失效。移除了手动解包辅助函数。

body.en: Section-banner decorations removed from comments across the codebase, with a zero-tolerance gate in repolint.
body.zh: 代码库中注释的分节横幅装饰已移除，repolint 中设为零容忍门禁。

title.zh: 修复 CLI 指标接收器重复转发

body.en: A bug where every event was forwarded twice on --metrics runs has been fixed, restoring single-forward behavior.
body.zh: 修复了 --metrics 运行时每个事件被转发两次的错误，恢复单次转发行为。

title.en: Session concurrency test stays within race budget
title.zh: 会话并发测试保持在竞态预算内

body.en: Reduced the volume of the session concurrency test to avoid timeout under the race detector, while maintaining overlap coverage.
body.zh: 减少会话并发测试的规模，避免在竞态检测器下超时，同时保持重叠覆盖。

title.en: CLI and SSH tests no longer reach the outside world
title.zh: CLI 和 SSH 测试不再访问外部网络

body.en: Tests that were inadvertently making real API calls or shelling out to host SSH are now properly isolated.
body.zh: 无意中进行真实 API 调用或调用主机 SSH 的测试现已正确隔离。

title.en: PR metadata gate rules documented and corrected
title.zh: PR 元数据门禁规则文档化并修正

body.en: The Documentation-impact gate is now documented, and the rejected-values line was corrected to match actual enforcement.
body.zh: Documentation-impact 门禁现已文档化，并修正了拒绝值行以匹配实际执行。

body.en: If you have a stuck pending update, it will auto-commit after 24 hours if install evidence holds. You can also discard it from Settings.
body.zh: 如果您有卡住的待更新事务，若安装证据有效，将在 24 小时后自动提交。您也可以从设置中放弃它。

summary.en: Fixes a permanent updater deadlock on Windows/macOS and a TUI watchdog false-kill issue, plus internal refactors for maintainability.
summary.zh: 修复了 Windows/macOS 上永久性的更新器死锁和 TUI 看门狗误杀问题，并进行了内部重构以提高可维护性。

title.en: Updater deadlock on Windows and macOS resolved
title.zh: 修复了 Windows 和 macOS 上的更新器死锁问题

body.en: Fixed an issue where the updater would permanently fail with "update recovery: could not safely finish the previous update" after an install layout change. The stale pending-update marker is now automatically quarantined, allowing future updates to proceed without manual intervention.
body.zh: 修复了安装布局更改后更新器永久失败并提示“update recovery: could not safely finish the previous update”的问题。现在过时的待处理更新标记会被自动隔离，无需手动干预即可继续后续更新。

title.en: TUI watchdog false kills and stall recovery
title.zh: TUI 看门狗误杀和卡顿恢复
